jobs.description: QuickMail is a cold email and LinkedIn outreach platform for markets you can't afford to burn. The Role We are hiring a technical customer support person with an owner's mentality. You will own support for QuickMail and Mailflow, our deliverability add-on. There is no first or second line. You are the first and last person our customers talk to. Customers count on you to solve their problems and find the real cause when something breaks. You work closely with engineering, and you tell the founder what we need to know to make the product better: where the friction is and where the opportunities are. The role covers the help desk, system health checks, testing new releases before they ship, and leading the weekly team meeting. It takes excellent communication, solid technical understanding and sharp critical thinking. This is not a script-reading job. Most tickets involve deliverability, DNS records, LinkedIn automation or campaign setup. You dig into customer accounts in our Support Dashboard, reproduce the issue, then decide what to do and how to explain it to the customer. We are a remote team spread across time zones. Most routine tasks have a written guide with a checklist, so you know what done looks like. You are expected to refine and improve those processes. When something new comes up, you work out the most efficient way to handle it. If you want a lot of autonomy across many areas, real responsibility and a fast-paced environment, this role is for you. What Work Looks Like You own two things: customers get unstuck fast, and the product stays reliable. Every day Set the day's support priorities and work the Help Scout queue for QuickMail and Mailflow. Triage, resolve, and dig deeper when a ticket needs it. Check the support dashboard: job queue, event-stream latency, blacklist status, newly purchased domains. If something is off, investigate, diagnose, and drive it to resolution. Review fraud alerts and disable accounts that are scams or abusing the platform. Delighting customers Comfortable jumping on calls with customers, building rapport fast, and setting them up for success. Update the changelog and help articles based on what shipped and what customers asked. Share customer feedback with the team, ask happy customers for reviews and case studies, and watch NPS for testimonial candidates. Making support smarter with AI Improve the AI support agent. Review its answers, fix the docs it drew from when it is wrong, and contact the customer when its reply was off. Write and maintain automated tests, built with AI, that try to break staging before customers do. Use the MCP connections we have in place (Helpscout, GitHub, Postmark, and others) to get an accurate picture of support and find the next thing worth improving. Keeping the product solid Gatekeep releases. New fixes and features land on staging every week. Test them, confirm when staging is ready to ship, and think through how existing and new users will be affected. Report bugs as GitHub issues with everything the developer needs: steps to reproduce, screenshots or a Loom, and any GraphQL or console errors. Captain red alerts. When a core feature breaks (emails not sending, login down), confirm it, alert the team on Slack or Telegram, update the status page every 30 minutes, keep affected customers informed, and drive the fix. Then run the retrospective so it does not happen twice. Running the week Lead the weekly team meeting in MonsterOps: issues written up, to-dos done, numbers updated. Keep rock status and KPIs current in MonsterOps. Tools you'll use: Helpscout, our Support Dashboard, Sidekiq, GitHub, Slack, Telegram, MonsterOps, Outline, MxToolbox, Postmark, Bento, TidyCal, Fathom, Visual Code and Claude. W

AI-Native Mindset: AI tools (Cursor, Claude and Gemini) are an integral part of your daily workflow. You view AI as an output amplifier, combine high curiosity with deep technical judgment, and reject skepticism toward AI-assisted coding. Location & Work Permit: You are based in Germany within a reasonable commuting distance to our Cologne office (NRW) and hold a valid German work permit. Full-Stack Core Stack: Deep expertise in modern Java (17+), the Spring Boot ecosystem (Spring Security, Spring Data JPA), React 18, TypeScript, Redux, and GraphQL (Apollo Client). Data & Testing Rigor: Strong hands-on experience with SQL/PostgreSQL, Flyway migrations, full-stack testing (Unit, Integration, E2E), and GitLab CI/CD pipelines. Languages: Business fluent English is required; German skills are a strong plus. Bonus Impact: Prior experience with semantic web tools (RDF, SPARQL, Apache Jena), Material UI (MUI 5), Elasticsearch, or pharma/life-sciences domains (FHIR, IDMP) is a major plus. Why you’ll love working here: Impactful Career Growth: Evolve into a Technical Lead / Lead Engineer role or deepen your specialization in semantic data platforms, AI features, or platform architecture as we scale. jobs.title: Software Entwickler:in mit Schwerpunkt GenAI
jobs.description: Wer wir sind Die Mayflower GmbH ist ein mittelständischer Dienstleister für Individualsoftware mit Schwerpunkt “Generative AI”. Seit 1998 in Gründerhand, entwickeln wir Software und beraten Kunden aus allen Branchen. Wir setzen auf Cloud Native, modernisieren Software und unterstützen unsere Kunden mit maßgeschneiderten AI-Lösungen. Wir bauen unseren Businessbereich “Generative AI” aus und suchen dafür dich, um gute Software für Kunden zu bauen, die relevante Probleme löst. Was dich erwartet Du entwickelst Individualsoftware für verschiedene Kunden und unterschiedlichste Use-Cases auf Basis von LLMs (z. B. GPT, Claude, Mistral) unter Nutzung von Frameworks und Bibliotheken wie LangChain, LangGraph, Open Hermes, Transformers für Generative AI- und RAG-Pipelines. Du nutzt und verarbeitet Daten über Embeddings, Vector-Datenbanken, APIs, Cloud-Speicher und Legacy-/Unternehmenssysteme, damit AI-Anwendungen mit relevanten Informationen arbeiten, um für den Kunden echten Mehrwert zu schaffen. Du bringst die Fähigkeit mit, dein bestehendes Know-How auf neue Herausforderungen anzuwenden. Du berätst unsere Kunden bei der fachlichen und technischen Umsetzung von GenAI-Anwendungen und deren Integration. Du teilst dein Wissen gerne, z. B. auf Konferenzen, Meetups oder in Fachartikeln. Du nutzt Open Source zur Problemlösung und lässt Verbesserungen und Erweiterungen zurückfließen. Du hast einen Blick auf den GenAI-Markt und die Weiterentwicklung von Technologien und Trends. Das solltest du mitbringen Mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise bei einem Individual-Software-Dienstleister oder IT-Beratung. Erfahrung mit RAG- oder RAG-Pipelines unter Verwendung von Embeddings, Vector-Datenbanken und LLMs. Grundkenntnisse in probabilistischem Testen mit Testsets und Qualitätssicherung mit Metriken. Du hast Spaß an der Interaktion mit Kunden (wie etwa bei der Beratung oder im Pre-Sales). Du sprichst verhandlungssicheres Deutsch auf C1+ Niveau sowie konversationssicheres Englisch. 1-2 Mal im Monat innerhalb Deutschlands zu reisen, um Kunden und Kolleg:innen persönlich zu treffen, stellt kein Hindernis für dich dar. Das haben wir zu bieten Kompetitive Vergütung: Je nachdem welche Erfahrungen und Kompetenzen du mitbringst, vergüten wir die Stelle mit einem Bruttojahresgehalt von 65.000 € bis 75.000 € bei 40 Wochenstunden. Kein 08/15: Bei unseren AI-Projekten sind Forschungsgeist und Experimentierfreude gefragt, da wir innovative Konzepte verproben, um Lösungen mit hohem Kundennutzen zu schaffen. Lass dich inspirieren: Arbeite mit einem der führenden Köpfe auf dem Gebiete der generative Artificial Intelligence - unserem CTO Mache einen Unterschied: Du hast bei uns viel Verantwortung und einen großen Gestaltungsspielraum. jobs.description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. The role We're hiring the first dedicated owner of central FP&A at ElevenLabs. You'll own the plan of record: the consolidated company model, the budgeting cycle and the monthly reporting cadence that the CFO, CEO and board use to run the company as we prepare for IPO. Pigment is in place and our data sits in a warehouse with dashboards on top, but the company isn't fully modeled yet. You'll build the core model first, then use it to evaluate every major investment. Build and own the driver-based company model and opex model in Pigment, bringing inputs from commercial, product and compute finance into one model of record. Run the annual budget and quarterly reforecasts end to end, including headcount envelopes and G&A forecasting with budget owners. Set up the monthly cadence of results, budget vs. actuals, functional reviews and quarterly business reviews, and prepare the financial section of the board pack. Bring capital allocation discipline to large decisions on hiring, compute and strategic spend. You're a builder who still builds the model yourself. You've likely done this at a high-growth tech company where the planning process had to be created while the business scaled, and you care about recommendations that get implemented, not only presented. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Direct Hotels
jobs.description: Why loveholidays? We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway. Our trailblaze together culture is what drives our success, powered by our people and the way they work. Using progressive technology, we drive cutting-edge innovation and improve how our customers discover, book and experience their holidays. You’ll have the opportunity to accelerate your growth through meaningful challenges, new experiences and the freedom to shape your own path. You’ll create impact for our future by taking ownership, contributing to shared goals and helping shape what comes next, all as part of our enhanced international community of talented, collaborative and passionate teams. The difference you’ll make You’ll own the products that help loveholidays grow direct relationships with hotels. By making it easier for partners to join us, manage their supply and improve their performance, you’ll help hotels achieve their commercial goals while giving our customers greater choice and value. Our ambition is to build an industry-leading operating system for our suppliers: bringing together onboarding, day-to-day management and the insights partners need to make better commercial decisions. You’ll help turn that ambition into a clear product direction. Your initial focus will be simplifying hotel onboarding and improving how effectively we turn direct hotel supply into bookings. You’ll be part of the Direct Hotels team, reporting to the Head of Product for Supply Platform. Working closely with Engineering, Design, Commercial, Operations and Analytics to build capabilities for hotel partners that support our broader supply strategy. The team sits within Platform, which provides shared technology and tools to help teams across loveholidays deliver the outcomes that drive value for our suppliers and experiences that delight our customers. Your day-to-day: Own the product direction and roadmap. Translate the Direct Hotels ambition into prioritised opportunities, clear outcomes and achievable delivery increments. Make informed trade-offs between supplier needs, commercial value and technical investment. Understand the people using our products. Work directly with hotel partners, contracting teams and loading operations to uncover problems, test ideas and understand what will drive adoption. Improve the journey from onboarding to bookable supply. Simplify how information is collected, checked and maintained, using automation and self-service where they make the experience easier to navigate and more reliable. Build towards supplier self-service. Develop capabilities that progressively give hotels more control over their relationship with us, working towards connected management tools and useful commercial insights. Take products from discovery through to measurable impact. Work closely with Engineering and Design to prototype, test, deliver and iterate. Explore practical applications of AI, define success measures and use evidence from adoption, supplier feedback and commercial performance to guide what comes next. Your skillset: Product ownership and strategic delivery: A track record of taking complex problems from discovery through to delivery and demonstrating meaningful user and business outcomes. The ability to connect a long-term vision to the next useful improvement, navigate uncertainty and drive delivery. Supplier and user understanding: The ability to understand different users’ goals and turn complicated workflows into useful, intuitive products. Experience with B2B, supplier, partner or marketplace products would be particularly valuable. Commercial and analytical judgement: Confidence connecting product decisions to growth, margin and operating costs, while considering value for both hotel partners and holidaymakers. Experience defining success measures, investigating performance and using data alongside qualitative research to make decisions.

jobs.title: Founding Account Executive - UK & Ireland
jobs.description: TL;DR - We’re building the healthcare workforce for tomorrow. Our AI receptionist Luna is already automating patient communication in medical practices today. As the market leader in German and Austrian dentistry, and with major funding under our belt, we’ve now launched Luna in the UK and Ireland, and are looking for our Founding Account Executive to build on that momentum. This isn't a "follow the playbook" role. You'll be our first person on the ground: growing our UK and Irish customer base and writing the playbook that everyone after you will follow. Why praxipal? The shortage of skilled professionals is the biggest challenge in our healthcare systems. Tens of thousands of positions remain unfilled each year, and demographic shifts are only making things worse. Medical practices rely on our AI receptionist Luna to reduce staff workload and keep care accessible for everyone. We’re growing at record speed and closed a $6.7M seed round with HV Capital. What We’re Looking For 2+ years of full-cycle B2B sales experience in a high-performing team, ideally a genuinely best-in-class sales organisation Ideally experience in high-velocity SMB sales: you know how to run short sales cycles, manage a high volume of deals and keep momentum without losing quality A consistent top performer with a track record of beating ambitious quotas, and the numbers to prove it Comfortable with ambiguity and excited to build processes from scratch rather than inherit them; startup or new-market experience is a big plus Someone people trust, who builds relationships that last well beyond the signature Ambitious and hungry to grow faster than any corporate career ladder would allow Excellent, persuasive English, both written and spoken Based in the UK or Ireland, or happy to relocate, with the right to work in either country What You’ll Do In short: turn our traction in the UK & Ireland into a thriving business by converting the strong demand we're seeing into customers. You'll own the full sales cycle, from first conversation and demo through to negotiating and closing You'll shape our go-to-market motion, working out what resonates with independent practices, dental groups and corporates, then doubling down on it You'll represent praxipal at industry events and build a name for us in the UK and Irish dental community You'll act as the voice of our customers, feeding insights straight to our product team so Luna is built for UK practices, NHS and private alike You’ll work hand in hand with marketing, turning what you learn in customer conversations into campaigns that bring in even more of the right customers What You’ll Get A genuine founding role: build a market from (almost) zero, backed by a funded, fast-growing company that has already done it more than once Room to grow with the business, with the opportunity to take on more responsibility as the UK&I team scales Onboarding at our Berlin HQ to kick things off, getting to know the core team, learning the product inside out and soaking up the culture before bringing it all back to the UK & Ireland Learning at the frontier of AI and healthcare, alongside a small, driven and talent-dense team Regular team events and offsites with the wider praxipal team Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Customer Facing Applied AI
jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Who We Are</strong></span></p> <p>Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.</p></div><h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>The Role</strong></span></h4> <p>The Applied AI team works embedded with Addepar's strategic clients to figure out where AI can change how they work and then build those capabilities from scratch. You'll spend time understanding a client's world, identify what's worth building, prototype it, prove it works, and then partner with core engineering teams to ship it as product for all customers.</p> <p>As an Applied AI Engineer, you'll build agentic systems from idea through production. The work starts with understanding the problem well enough to know what to build, then moves fast through prototyping and iteration. You'll design agent behavior, wire up tool integrations, tune evaluations until the AI actually works in practice. You'll sit close to the people who use what you build, and that feedback loop is how both the product and your skills grow fast. The team is new. Your work shapes what we ship.</p> <p>This role may require occasional work outside standard business hours to accommodate client time zones and up to 15% travel to client sites, including occasional overnight and multi-day engagements.</p> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What You'll Do</strong></span></h4> <ul> <li>Build AI-powered agents and tools end-to-end: identify the problem with clients and domain experts, prototype quickly, evaluate rigorously, and ship to production</li> <li>Design and implement LLM integrations including prompt engineering, function calling, structured outputs, and retrieval-augmented workflows</li> <li>Define evaluation criteria and build test harnesses for AI systems where correctness is ambiguous and domain-specific</li> <li>Work directly with clients to understand their workflows, validate AI behavior, and iterate toward production quality</li> <li>Partner with core engineering teams to generalize client-specific work into product features</li> <li>Contribute to shared AI infrastructure (agent frameworks, tool integrations, deployment pipelines)</li> <li>Monitor and maintain production AI systems with attention to reliability, cost, and performance</li> </ul> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Who You Are</strong></span></h4> <ul> <li>Extensive professional software engineering experience</li> <li>Professional experience with Python (the team's primary language)</li> <li>Experience working with LLM APIs (Claude, GPT, or similar) including function calling and structured outputs</li> <li>Comfort with SQL for data exploration and building data-grounded AI workflows</li> <li>Experience with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Codex, or similar)</li> <li&g

jobs.title: Assistant General Counsel – Product and Regulatory Legal (EU)
jobs.description: Building the Future of Open Finance Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work. The team Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Join our Product and Regulatory Legal team, embedded with Kraken's Product, Design and Engineering teams to ship novel products and experiences that accelerate the global adoption of crypto. We are a tight, experienced group of lawyers from a diverse range of tradfi, fintech and crypto backgrounds who move fast, stay curious and take pride in the commercial accountability of our advice, partnering directly with Product, senior leadership and Compliance to chart clear, defensible paths to launch and to keep our licensed entities running smoothly. This is a senior product-facing legal role for the European Union. You will be the lawyer the business trusts on questions that cut across several regimes at once: for example, a single product such as a tokenised equity, a card, or an institutional custody and prime brokerage service can touch the Markets in Financial Instruments Directive ("MiFID II"), the Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation ("MiCA"), the Payment Services Directive ("PSD2"), the Electronic Money Directive ("EMD2") and banking rules at the same time. jobs.description: We’re Heidi. We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties. Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart. We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again. We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years. If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in. The role We’re looking for a doctor who has moved into AI and can code, to join Clinical AI R&D as a Clinical AI Engineer. You’ll sit inside a product pod and own the evidence for its product: define the evaluation before anyone builds, run it to a standard a journal reviewer would accept, keep watching the product once it ships, publish what the evidence shows, and change the product when the evidence says to. The pod’s engineers can change the product but can’t judge whether a discharge summary missed something a consultant would catch. Clinicians can make that call but can’t open a pull request. You do both, and you treat the gap between a model’s output and good clinical practice as the thing you’re here to measure and close. The loop doesn’t end at launch. You stay with the product for its life in market. What you’ll do Design the evaluation. Define evaluations for greenfield products to an academic standard: endpoints, comparators, ground truth, sample size, analysis plan. Set the bar before the result arrives. Build the measurement. Build, optimize and validate the LLM judges and rubrics that score the product at scale. Report their agreement with clinician ground truth, not their convenience, and retire the ones that drift. Run it and write it up. Execute the evaluation, do the statistics, and write it up once in a form that serves the pod, the regulatory file and an academic submission. Run post-market surveillance. Monitor output quality in production and respond to regulatory feedback with data. Our clinical safety team triages complaints and incidents; you’re their counterpart in the pod, working out what their findings mean for the product and what should change. Fix what the evidence finds. Prompt and rubric changes, evaluation harness changes, code changes in the pod’s codebase, shipped through the pod’s normal review and release process. Publish. Contribute to peer-reviewed literature on the translational benefit of the product. Be the clinician in the room. Catch the output that reads well and is wrong. Hold the line on clinical nuance when a shortcut would ship faster. What you'll need A medical degree and clinical practice with independent clinical judgment. This role runs on medical nuance, and this requirement doesn’t flex. Academic depth. Study design, inferential statistics, agreement and reliability measures, sample size, handling of multiple comparisons. Thesis or publication-level work, not a methods module. Experience evaluating medical software or clinical AI, including building or validating LLM-as-judge pipelines. Enough engineering to work in a production codebase. jobs.title: Director, Luxury Market Intelligence & Insights
jobs.description: We are growing! We are currently looking to hire a Director, Luxury Market Intelligence & Insights .   About CXG: Founded in 2006, CXG is a global customer experience company uniquely positioned at the intersection of data-driven retail performance, customer experience transformation, and operational execution across 200+ luxury brands worldwide. The mission of our 270 collaborators is to help brands transform customer and employee experiences through tailored insights, strategy, and implementation. We are passionate about delivering impact. Our clients include the world's most admired luxury houses, and our solutions combine research, technology, and human expertise to elevate every customer interaction. We are looking for a thought leadership expert with the editorial vision to spot what matters next, the conviction to shape CXG's point of view, and the writing talent to make it influential across luxury retail, beauty and cosmetics, watches and jewellery, automotive, and hospitality. Context and role Reporting to the Chief of Staff, you will lead CXG's Thought Leadership and Market Intelligence functions. You will define the topics on which CXG should have a distinctive and credible point of view, turn CXG's proprietary data, expertise and market knowledge into original external content, and position the company ahead of emerging developments in customer experience, luxury and its priority verticals. This is a hands-on role: you will research, analyse, write and produce content yourself, while mobilising expertise and data from across the business. You will be accountable for ensuring that every publication presents a recognisable CXG angle rather than simply reporting market developments or repeating established industry views. You will manage one Market Intelligence team member. Thought Leadership Development Define the thought leadership strategy and roadmap, including priority themes, target audiences, formats and a realistic publication calendar. Drive and coordinate content creation across Practices, Solutions and Regions. Work closely with Practices, Regions and Solutions to: Push: scan for trends and hot topics and ensure CXG has a voice and perspective, commenting regularly on these subjects. Pull: identify and collect new ideas and proposed topics from the relevant stakeholders, prioritise and incorporate them into the thought leadership roadmap. Use market intelligence, CXG's proprietary data, internal expertise and client-facing insights to identify emerging topics early, develop a clear CXG point of view and decide where CXG can make a credible contribution to the conversation. Research, interview internal experts, write and edit articles, perspectives and other thought leadership content directly. Challenge generic claims and ensure each piece advances a clear argument and is supported by credible evidence. Ensure that analysis is methodologically sound, appropriately contextualised and presented without compromising client confidentiality. Develop topics that connect expertise across Practices and Regions, while reflecting relevant differences between markets. Thought Leadership Communication Ensure relevant thought leadership pieces (e.g., perspectives, publications) are disseminated on a periodic basis. Work with Marketing on the publication, distribution and promotion of content, while retaining ownership of the editorial strategy, substance, quality and consistency of CXG's point of view. In addition, collaborate with Marketing to maximise impact by communicating through the channels relevant to each market. Track the reach, engagement and qualitative response generated by CXG's thought leadership, as well as relevant business enquiries influenced by published content. Use the findings to refine the roadmap. Shape and host or contribute to CXG's podcast "The Luxury Edit", working with internal experts and guests to develop topics, prepare interviews and turn conversations into useful content

jobs.title: Customer Care Specialist
jobs.description: Making preventive health the default for every human in Europe The mission At Lucis , we believe healthcare should be preventive, not reactive. We’re building the OS for human longevity to help people add more healthy years to their lives. You can read more about who we are and how we work here . The role Health is complex, personal, and deeply important to our members. As the voice of Lucis clients, you support them throughout their health journey and own member happiness end to end. With rapid member growth, we are hiring our first dedicated Customer Care Team Lead . You will own the member experience end-to-end, stabilize our operational metrics, and build and manage a world-class support team. What you will own Member support: Resolve member and lab partner inquiries via chat, email and phone, with warmth, precision and a sense of urgency. Phone-first when it matters: Pick up the phone whenever a situation calls for a human voice: a delayed result, a stressful moment, a confused member. Know your boundaries: Work hand in hand with our medical team and know exactly when to escalate a health question rather than answer it yourself. Voice of the member: Spot recurring issues and turn them into clear, structured feedback for the product and ops teams. Contribute to projects: Take part in initiatives that improve the member experience, like rebuilding our Help Center, designing proactive care for lab delays, or automating repetitive workflows with AI. About you You’re passionate about the future of human health and want your work to help people stay healthy for longer. You move quickly from idea to execution, take full ownership of what you build, and work best with talented people who care as much as you do. You thrive in fast‑moving environments, learn by doing, and value feedback as a way to continuously improve. You use AI the way others use a calculator: naturally, to go faster and think bigger. You’ll fit in well if Experience: 1+ years in B2C customer care, support, hospitality, or any role where you dealt directly with customers. Strong recent graduates with relevant experience are welcome too. Bilingual: Fluent in both English and French, written and spoken. People-first energy: You bring genuine warmth and empathy to every interaction, and you turn routine support into memorable experiences. Rigorous precision: Exceptional attention to detail, with zero tolerance for misquotes, wrong information or operational errors. In health, accuracy is care. Builder mindset: When something breaks twice, your instinct is to fix the root cause, not just the ticket. Nice to have Support tooling: You've used Intercom or similar support tools. AI automation: You've already used AI tools to automate part of your work. Startup mindset: You thrive in early-stage environments with high autonomy, rapid execution and clear communication. The process Intro call, culture & role fit (20 min) Case study interview (30-60 min) Deep dive and team chat, on-site (2 hours) Reference calls How we work We work together from our Paris hub. We’re passionate about what we’re building and believe the fastest way to create something exceptional is side by side. We’re open to relocation support for the right individuals, and we welcome missionaries who travel to work with us in Paris on a regular basis. Rigor without ego: Audits, science, and code all deserve the same high bar. Radical ownership: Feedback loops are short; everyone contributes to building the best version of Lucis. Velocity over perfection: We ship daily and prefer a good decision today over a perfect one next week. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Head of Security
jobs.description: About Morpho Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world. Why Morpho Exists Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here . Location: Paris or remote (from -5h GMT up to +2h GMT to ensure sufficient overlap with the rest of the team). About the role: As Head of Security, you'll define and drive Morpho's security strategy across the entire organization - corporate IT, cloud and infrastructure, application, supply chain, identity, incident response, threat intelligence, and counterparty security - and you'll build the team and function to deliver it. This is a hands-on leadership role: in the early days you'll personally do the work while you hire, and you'll stay close enough to the technical detail to earn the trust of a deeply technical organization. You'll also be Morpho's credible security voice, internally to leadership, and externally to the integrators, institutions, and ecosystem partners who depend on us. You'll partner closely with Engineering on infrastructure and deployment integrity, and with our Integration team, which works with various partners across the Morpho ecosystem. Responsibilities: Own and continuously evolve Morpho's security strategy and roadmap across, cloud/infrastructure, application, supply-chain, identity, and operational security. Build and lead the security function - hire, grow, and develop the team, recruiting skillsets across security operations and application security. Oversight of the IT function Stay hands-on. Personally execute critical security work - threat modeling, architecture review, control implementation, and incident command - while the team scales. Set the governance architecture: a coherent security framework that ties tooling and controls together, rather than accumulating tools in isolation. Own incident response end to end - runbooks, incident command, severity and escalation structure, and market communication during an event. Build and run a counterparty security program for curators and partners - identity verification, screening, operational diligence, and bidirectional incident-coordination channels. Lead Morpho's certification strategy (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001), meeting both the spirit and the letter sustainably. jobs.title: Leiter Automatisierungstechnik Siemens TIA
jobs.description: About EH Group Engineering EHG is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product is a significantly more compact fuel cell with high power density and lower costs of production. Faced with the challenges of climate change and the transition to a decentralised energy system, EHG seeks to provide high performance and cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners. To help bring this vision to life, we are looking for a Senior Control Engineer to coordinate our efforts in designing control strategies for containerized systems integrating our fuel cell technology alongside equipment such as gas reformers, batteries, and climate control units. You will coordinate the control team and play a key role in shaping how these complex, multi-equipment systems operate safely and efficiently in the field. Based in the US? You’re welcome to apply. This is an on-site role in Nyon, Switzerland. We ask that you relocate within 3 months of starting, and we’ll support you with a relocation package. Key Responsibilities: Coordinate the control engineering activities and define the control architecture and technical roadmap for our fuel cell and containerized power systems Develop control strategies, models and algorithms for test-benches, fuel cell system and containerized power supply systems using Matlab/Simulink and Siemens PLCs Coordinate the transition of prototype control algorithms from Simulink to industrial-quality code in TIA Portal Step 7 Implement, tune and validate controllers for thermal, air, fuel and power subsystems Define and own control requirements, state machines and safety/diagnostic logic Drive the continuous improvement (performance, efficiency and robustness) of our products Define and oversee model-in-the-loop (MIL) testing and validation procedures Manage the complete software life cycle, from requirements through release and maintenance, including dataset management Establish coding standards, conduct code reviews and ensure compliance with industrial and certification requirements Coordinate and develop the control team, including task planning and prioritization Act as the main control interface with embedded, test and electrical engineering, as well as external partners and suppliers Skills and Experience Required: BSc/MSc in control, electrical, mechatronic or automation engineering is mandatory Minimum 7 years of experience in control engineering, including at least 2 years in a technical lead or senior role Skill 1 : Strong experience in process control engineering, particularly with containerized power supply systems; knowledge of programming and implementing safety PLCs is a strong plus Skill 2 : Strong experience with TIA Portal (Step 7, WinCC, Test Suite), with the ability to structure code to industrial standards and meet certification requirements Experience with functional safety (e.g. IEC 61508, ISO 13849), including SIL/PL determination and implementation of safety functions Experience across the complete V-model development cycle, including hazard and risk assessment, requirements definition, safety requirements specification (SRS), verification and validation, and dataset management Experience with stationary and maritime power applications, with a focus on the US and EU markets and their respective standards and certification requirements Proven team player, with the ability to: (i) Coordinate and mentor the control team by clearly explaining your code and helping the team adopt robust industrial methods: you will take the responsibility in developing Skill 1 and Skill 2 across the team (ii) Collaborate effectively within interdisciplinary teams Solid knowledge of control theory, state machines and system identification Strong experience with MATLAB/Simulink and model-based design is a plus Professional working language is in English. Start date: Immediately Find Jobs in Switzerland on A

jobs.title: Responsable Qualité Multi-Sites - Piles à Combustible
jobs.description: About EHG EH Group (EHG) is a rapidly growing fuel cell power platform delivering onsite power to AI data centers, defense, and industry. Our fuel-agnostic proton exchange membrane (PEM) systems scale from kW-scale units to GW-scale power plants, and we design, manufacture, and deploy them for customers worldwide. Founded in Switzerland, EHG is now expanding into the United States, fueled by exponential AI data center power demand and a soon-to-be-announced major investment round. This is a defining, high-growth chapter for the company. The opportunity We're hiring a Quality Manager to own a single quality system across both of our production streams — our established MW-scale facility in Nyon, Switzerland and our new US operation in Houston, Texas. You'd be based in Nyon, where our production and process knowledge sits today, and own quality for the US operation as it stands up. The requirement is explicit: quality must be identical at both sites. Same specifications, same control plans, same acceptance criteria, same records. A customer taking delivery of a system should not be able to tell which site built the stack inside it, and our certification and warranty position depends on being able to demonstrate that. Our customers are data center operators, defense programs, and industrial sites where reliability is the product. In your first year you'd harmonize our quality management system across both entities, establish controls in Houston that match those proven in Nyon as manufacturing technology transfers, build supplier quality alongside Supply Chain for a shared global supply base, and support certification of our systems for both European and US markets. Location & travel: Nyon-based. Regular travel to Houston is expected as the US operation stands up, along with travel to supplier and partner sites in Europe and the US. What you'll own One quality management system across both entities — a common QMS covering Nyon and Houston, including the path to ISO 9001 certification in the US and alignment with what is already established in Switzerland. Equivalence between sites. A single set of product specifications, control plans, inspection criteria, and acceptance standards, with a defined process for how any change is applied at both sites rather than one. In-process quality for fuel cell stack production at both locations, including the process controls that matter most in stack assembly — cleanliness and contamination control, leak testing, torque and compression control, and alignment. Supplier quality for a shared global supply base , working with Supply Chain on qualification, audits, first article inspection, part submission, and ongoing performance, with one qualification standard regardless of which site a supplier serves. Quality oversight of contract manufacturing and assembly partners building balance of plant and containerized systems on our behalf in both regions — audits, quality agreements, source inspection, and acceptance criteria. Nonconformance and corrective action across both sites , including NCR and CAPA processes and structured problem solving, with findings at one site systematically applied at the other. Traceability and product records — a common lot genealogy model from raw material through stack serial to delivered system, and the test and inspection data that supports warranty, certification, and customer acceptance, held consistently across both entities. Certification across regions , working with external certification partners on the standards applicable to stationary hydrogen power systems in Europe and the US, authority having jurisdiction approvals, and marine classification where relevant. Quality culture on both floors , including operator training, work instruction discipline, and establishing the habits in Houston that are already proven in Nyon, as US headcount grows quickly. jobs.title: Manager Operations Planning & Performance
jobs.description: Bij Crisp hebben we een missie: eten met meer smaak bereikbaar maken voor iedereen. Daarvoor moet elke schakel in onze operatie, van warehouse tot voordeur, dagelijks naadloos op elkaar aansluiten. Als Manager Operations Planning & Performance ben jij de spil tussen wat de klant bestelt en hoe wij dat logistiek waarmaken. Je brengt alle operationele schakels samen in één strakke, integrale planning en bouwt mee aan een betrouwbare operatie die klaar is om slim door te groeien. Wat je gaat doen Je bent eigenaar van de integrale operationele planning. Je vertaalt verwachte klantvraag naar concrete capaciteit op de weg (hoeveel bezorgers hebben we per dag en per hub nodig?) en bepaalt samen met de Operations Manager de planningsstrategie voor de korte en middellange termijn. Je zorgt voor een strakke planning tussen Delivery, Retentie en Warehouse. Zo werkt iedereen vanuit dezelfde basis en tilt jouw scherpe blik onze processen naar een hoger niveau. Je geeft leiding aan een team van routeplanners (werkstudenten en starters). Samen zorgen jullie dagelijks voor de meest efficiënte bezorgroutes. Jouw team staat in direct contact met de bezorghubs, het warehouse en de growth afdeling om de capaciteit af te stemmen Je werkt nauw samen met teams door de hele organisatie, van Tech en Analytics tot Recruitment. Om te weten wat er speelt, ben je regelmatig te vinden waar het gebeurt: op onze bezorghubs en in het warehouse. Je stuurt op operationele KPI’s (zoals Drops per Hour en Time per Stop ) en beheert belangrijke kostenlijnen. Samen met de Regiomanager en Business Analyst Delivery blijf je ons bezorgnetwerk continu optimaliseren. Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor de lijn tussen ons warehouse en de hubs. Je onderhoudt de contacten met vrachtwagenvervoerders, stuurt op prestaties ( On Time ) en kosten ( Cost per Drop ) en maximaliseert de vulgraad. Je kijkt altijd naar wat beter kan, houdt trends en innovaties in de markt in de gaten en draagt dit actief aan wanneer je hier kansen ziet. Je signaleert kansen in de operatie, maakt de impact inzichtelijk en leidt verbeterprojecten van idee tot implementatie, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van servicetijd, automatisering van planningstaken of de inrichting van ons netwerk. Je bent onderdeel van het Delivery team en rapporteert aan de Head of Delivery. Dit ben jij Je hebt HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau en minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring in operationele planning, logistiek of supply chain, bij voorkeur in een snelgroeiende e-commerce- of retailomgeving. Je beweegt je makkelijk door de hele organisatie, van de vloer tot het management. Je zoekt actief de samenwerking op en krijgt verschillende teams moeiteloos op één lijn. Je creëert draagvlak en krijgt mensen mee in een gezamenlijke aanpak, ook als je geen formele zeggenschap over ze hebt Je bent sterk met data. Je duikt zelf in de cijfers, bouwt een model of dashboard als dat nodig is, en vertaalt analyses naar concrete keuzes voor de operatie. Ervaring met SQL, BigQuery en Data Studio is een pré. Jij kijkt verder dan je eigen scope en overziet de hele keten. Je begrijpt hoe een keuze in de planning doorwerkt in het warehouse, op de weg en bij de klant, en je weet de juiste balans te vinden tussen kosten en kwaliteit. Je bent resultaatgericht en weet wat het is om eigenaarschap te nemen. Jij maakt dingen graag makkelijk en concreet. Complexe vraagstukken zet jij gemakkelijk om naar begrijpelijke acties. Je houdt het hoofd koel als het even spannend wordt. Pieken, onverwachte uitval of last-minute wijzigingen brengen je niet van je stuk; je prioriteert, plant opnieuw en zorgt dat de operatie doordraait. Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Wat wij bieden Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op het Europese voedselsysteem. 27 vakantiedagen om bij te komen en op te laden. Een extra vrije dag per jaar om je in te zetten voor vrijwilligerswerk en iets goeds te doen. Aandacht voor je menta

jobs.title: Project Leider Bouw
jobs.description: Monumental automatiseert de bouw met robotica en software. Onze missie is om de bouw software-defined en autonoom te maken – een toekomst waarin mooie gebouwen op maat in één dag verrijzen, met minimale inzet van handwerk. We zijn een groeiend team van engineers, operators en technici, afkomstig van bedrijven als Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta en Google DeepMind. We staan nog aan het begin van het opbouwen van dit bedrijf, en dit is je kans om buitenproportioneel veel impact te maken op een probleem dat écht uitmaakt. Vanaf dag één werk je samen met een ervaren foundingteam, met een Series B van $32M achter ons onder leiding van Khosla Ventures en Plural. Monumental zit in het centrum van Amsterdam, in een prachtig pand met een volledig uitgeruste werkplaats en een eigen testvloer voor robots. We bouwen de hele stack in-house – hardware én software. We zijn uitdrukkelijk geen hybride of remote-first bedrijf: robots en muren bouw je niet vanaf je keukentafel, dus we werken vijf dagen per week op locatie. Lees meer over waarom wij vinden dat je je tijd aan de bouw zou moeten besteden, en over onze visie en ons bedrijf . Misschien vind je ons YouTube-kanaal interessant, de film van Based in Europe over hoe we het Europese woningtekort aanpakken , of deze video van Andreas Klinger over hoe ons kantoor eruitziet. Over de functie De afgelopen jaren is Monumental gegroeid van een werkend product en de eerste proefprojecten naar bouwen op grote schaal. Inmiddels hebben we een vloot van meer dan 150 robots, die metselwerk hebben uitgevoerd voor meer dan 90 woningen, een school, een buurthuis, een hotel en meer dan 150 meter kanaalwand. Elke maand nemen we meer bouwprojecten aan, intern noemen we die ‘deployments’. We werken met meer robots en meer mensen en breiden vanuit Nederland uit naar het Verenigd Koninkrijk en de VS. Als Hub Lead zet je onze eerste vestiging buiten het hoofdkantoor op, in het noorden van Nederland. Je begint met ons grootste bouwproject tot nu toe. Naarmate er meer projecten bijkomen, bouw je het team en de operatie verder uit. We zoeken mensen die breed inzetbaar zijn en een bouwproject willen leiden alsof het hun eigen bedrijf is. Achter elk project staat een Deployment Manager die van begin tot eind verantwoordelijk is. In de praktijk vervul je vijf rollen tegelijk: uitvoerder, operationeel manager, accountmanager, analist en projectmanager. Je maakt het bouwplan, voert het met je team als onderaannemer uit, onderhoudt het contact met de aannemer en zorgt dat we goed metselwerk op tijd opleveren. Dat doe je in de bouw, waar plannen voortdurend veranderen. Uiteindelijk leid je meerdere projecten tegelijk, waaronder complexe projecten waarbij veel op het spel staat. De ene dag sta je bij zonsopgang op en ga je naar de bouwplaats. Je zaagt stenen, bewaakt de planning, stemt af met de hoofdaannemer en ziet je bouwplan steen voor steen werkelijkheid worden. De volgende dag zit je op onze vestiging, analyseer je de winst- en verliesrekening van je project en werk je aan systemen waarmee je bij het volgende project een betere marge haalt. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de oplevering en geeft knelpunten die je op de bouwplaats tegenkomt door aan ons R&D-team. Dit is intensief, praktisch werk op locatie, waar je veel voldoening uit kunt halen. Robots gaan kapot, het weer slaat om en de aannemer verandert het plan. Jij zorgt dat de bouw doorgaat. Je krijgt veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid. De rol past goed bij je als je eerder een bedrijf hebt opgericht, of als je een ondernemende functie zoekt waarin je veel invloed hebt op het resultaat. Wat je gaat doen De logistiek van een bouwproject plannen. Je bepaalt hoeveel en welke robots en mensen nodig zijn, stemt af met andere onderaannemers en maakt de dagelijkse planning. Tegelijk houd je het grotere geheel in het oog en begrijp je wat jouw keuzes betekenen voor de kosten en opbrengsten per project. Op de bouwplaats het team aansturen, begeleiden

jobs.title: BDR Talent Programme (Amsterdam)
jobs.description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. About the Programme This is a structured 18–24 month global programme designed to launch high-potential commercial careers. You don’t need prior sales or payments experience; what you need is ambition, curiosity, resilience, and the drive to build relationships and solve complex problems. You will join a global cohort of Business Development Representatives (BDRs) with structured learning, dedicated coaching from sales leaders, and real commercial responsibility from month one. Throughout the programme, you will master enterprise sales: researching strategic accounts, engaging senior decision-makers, conducting sharp discovery conversations, and building pipeline that drives real business growth. High performers transition into Sales, Account Management, and other commercial roles across the business. Many of our top commercial leaders, including our Chief Revenue Officer, started their journey at Checkout.com as BDRs or interns. Whether you are a recent graduate, an early-career professional with 1–3 years of experience, or a career switcher, what matters most is your hunger to learn and achieve. What You’ll Do Research Strategic Accounts: Identify high-value targets by researching key organizations, industries, and executive stakeholders. Initiate High-Impact Outreach: Open doors with senior decision-makers using personalized outreach across email, phone, and LinkedIn. Build Qualified Pipeline: Drive consistent growth momentum through disciplined prospecting, rigorous follow-up, and account mapping. Run Consultative Discovery: Uncover merchants' technical and business challenges to align Checkout.com ’s solutions with their goals. Partner on Live Deals: Work alongside Sales Representatives to support opportunities through to deal execution. Leverage AI & Modern Tech: Use CRM, intent data, and approved AI tools to streamline research, refine outreach, and work smarter. Who We’re Looking For We welcome applications from recent graduates and professionals with 1–3 years of experience looking to change careers. Regardless of your background, we are looking for the following core skills to set you up for success: Driven & Goal-Oriented: You set high personal standards, work hard, and stay motivated when tackling challenging commercial goals. Resilient & Adaptable: You bounce back quickly from rejection, view obstacles as practice, and maintain consistent output. Relational & Engaging: You genuinely enjoy starting conversations, asking sharp questions, and building trust with diverse stakeholders. Track Record of Achievement: You demonstrate drive and ownership through professional, academic, athletic, or entrepreneurial success. Commercial & Tech Curiosity: You are eager to learn complex fintech products and use AI and sales tools to work smarter. Coachability & Clear Communication: You listen well, articulate ideas clearly, and actively apply feedback to improve performance. What You’ll Get Out of It A 2-year structured programme that ensures you have a successful career in sales.

jobs.title: Process Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Functieprofiel Als Process Automation Engineer speel je een cruciale rol in het hart van onze productieomgeving. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het beheren, onderhouden en continu verbeteren van het procesautomatiseringslandschap (ISA‑niveaus 1, 2 en 3 – zowel hardware als software). Je borgt de betrouwbaarheid en beschikbaarheid van onze productieprocessen en vertaalt data en technologie naar slimme, praktische verbeteringen die de organisatie vooruithelpen. Dit is een hands‑on functie met veel impact, waarin je nauw samenwerkt met Operations, Production Support Engineering en externe technologiepartners. Bedrijfsomschrijving NX Filtration bevindt zich in een spannende groeifase, gedreven door een unieke en impactvolle technologie. Met onze missie “pure en betaalbare wateroplossingen voor iedereen” ontwikkelen en produceren wij geavanceerde holle‑vezelmembranen voor nano‑, ultra‑ en microfiltratie. Onze technologie verwijdert de kleinste verontreinigingen uit water, waaronder nanoplastics, organische stoffen, kleurstoffen, medicijnresten, bacteriën en virussen. Hiermee maken wij eenvoudige, efficiënte en duurzame oplossingen mogelijk voor waterzuivering, hergebruik van afvalwater en drinkwaterproductie wereldwijd. Door bij NX Filtration te werken, draag je direct bij aan het oplossen van mondiale uitdagingen op het gebied van waterkwaliteit en waterschaarste. Wat ga jij doen! In deze dynamische rol houd je je bezig met: Beheren, onderhouden en verder ontwikkelen van procesautomatiseringssystemen (ISA‑niveaus 1, 2 en 3) Continu verbeteren van het NX Production Data Platform Initiëren, uitwerken en implementeren van technische verbeteringen en procesoptimalisaties Ondersteunen van Operations bij automatiseringsincidenten, inclusief deelname aan de storingsdienst Zorgen voor een hoge beschikbaarheid en kwaliteit van productie‑ en QC‑data en actieve ondersteuning van data‑analyses Voorstellen van automatisering‑ en digitaliseringsprojecten en – na goedkeuring – deze voorbereiden en uitvoeren Adviseren van de organisatie over nieuwe technologische ontwikkelingen en toekomstbestendige oplossingen Actief bijdragen aan het versterken van cybersecurity binnen het OT‑domein Wat wij vragen! Jij bent een proactieve automatiseringsprofessional met een passie voor technologie en verbetering: Een afgeronde bachelor‑ of masteropleiding in Informatica, Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of een vergelijkbare richting Minimaal 3 tot 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in procesautomatisering Hands‑on ervaring met Siemens Step7 / TIA Portal / WinCC Ervaring met ProLeiT Plant.iT Bij voorkeur ervaring met OPC UA en AVEVA PI De bereidheid om jezelf én de organisatie continu te blijven ontwikkelen Wat bieden wij jou! Werken bij NX Filtration biedt je de kans om samen met een gedreven en enthousiast team een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan de professionalisering en groei van de organisatie. Je werkt in een open en informele omgeving met zeer korte communicatielijnen, waarin eigen initiatief wordt gestimuleerd. Het betreft een zelfstandige functie binnen een snelgroeiende, dynamische organisatie in een internationale setting, waar je volop ruimte krijgt om jezelf te ontwikkelen – zowel persoonlijk als in je loopbaanambities. Daarnaast: In 2024 is een nieuwe fabriek gerealiseerd Alle processen zijn volledig geautomatiseerd met ProLeiT Volledige data‑integratie ten behoeve van diepgaande procesanalyses Mogelijkheden voor remote support Geïnteresseerd!  Solliciteer dan snel via onze website. jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: Role summary Bluerock TMS builds the autonomous orchestration platform that keeps global logistics moving — orchestrating complex, multi-modal transport networks for customers across fashion, food & beverage, manufacturing, healthcare, and more. Real complexity, at real scale, every single day. We're looking for a Product Manager who has actually lived inside logistics or TMS operations. Someone who can understand operations complexity and who is willing to take on this challenge and contribute hands on to build the next level of TMS. You'll own the products that turn that complexity into clarity, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, sales, and implementation to make sure what we build actually gets adopted. Responsibilities Product vision, grounded in real user needs You dig past what customers ask for to find the problem underneath, and turn that into a direction for your area the company can rally behind. Market scoping and opportunity-spotting Scanning the logistics landscape, competitor moves, and customer signals to find where Bluerock should build next, not just what's already on the backlog. Logistics know-how turned into product decisions   Planning, transport execution, freight, last-mile — decisions that hold up against how operations actually run, not just how they're described to you. The full lifecycle From first idea to adoption. You don't hand off and disappear. The connective tissue across the company   When priorities compete or a customer escalation needs an answer fast, you're the one pulling the threads together. The team you’ll join You'll join an international product team with complementary skills and a shared passion for a good challenge, real, hands-on experience in logistics paired with genuine enthusiasm for technology. We don't settle for quick patches: we strive for quality, look for the sustainable solution over the easy one, and keep an eye on what next-level TMS should look like, not just what's in front of us today. Life at Bluerock We're a distributed team across the Netherlands, Italy, the US, and Canada that operates like one crew: local insight, global perspective. We're curious by default, self-driven without needing to be told twice, and genuinely joyful about solving hard logistics problems together. We're team-minded because the best answers rarely come from one person alone, and unapologetically reliable because our customers' supply chains don't get a “we'll fix it next sprint.” As one of us put it: at the end of the day, it's the people that make Bluerock. 5+ years in product or project management within logistics, supply chain, or TMS — hands-on TMS experience is required. Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Business Administration, Information Systems, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field  required. A track record of delivering complex, high-stakes software implementations , on time and within budget. Genuine ease operating cross-functionally . You connect engineering, sales, implementation, and customers without waiting for permission. An appetite for ambiguity and change : a messy, fragmented workflow reads to you as an interesting problem. Nice to have: API integration experience (WMS, ERP, visibility providers, customs), fluency with Agile tooling (Jira, Asana, Rocketlane), and PMP/PRINCE2 certification. Excellent leadership and team management skills , with the ability to motivate and guide cross-functional teams. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage customer relationships and stakeholder expectations effectively. Exceptional problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a focus on delivering results in a fast-paced environment Our hiring process Hit the Apply button. Join a 30 minute video call in the Introduction Interview A couple of deeper interviews built to be a win-win, not an interrogation. An offer, and the start of your journey with Bluerock TMS. jobs.description: Cordaan biedt zorg binnen en buiten Amsterdam aan en wil zich onderscheiden als leerbedrijf. Wij hebben voor diverse beroepsopleidingen in de zorg een stageplek op maat. Dus ook voor jou!  Er is veel aandacht voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling en we zorgen voor een gedegen begeleiding. Na je sollicitatie zoeken we samen met het opleidingsbureau naar de beste stageplek. Als student breng je tenslotte ook kennis, vaardigheden en nieuwe inzichten mee en daarmee doen wij ons voordeel. Zo werkt het twee kanten op. jobs.title: Senior interim manager in de zorg in loondienst
jobs.description: Ben jij een ervaren leider die energie krijgt van het aanbrengen van structuur in uitdagende situaties? Hou je ervan om orde op zaken te stellen en daarna door te gaan naar de volgende interne opdracht? Word jij blij van de afwisseling en uitdaging van een projectmatige rol en met de zekerheid en voordelen van een baan in loondienst? Dan is deze rol als interim manager bij Cordaan iets voor jou!   Wat ga je doen?   Als interim manager word je ingezet op locaties van Cordaan waar extra leiderschap en verandering nodig zijn. Dit betekent dat je tijdelijke projectmatige opdrachten uitvoert in de organisatie, waar je snel schakelt, structuur aanbrengt en teams in crisis helpt stabiliseren. Je start elke opdracht met het maken van een projectplan en zorgt dat dit succesvol wordt uitgevoerd. Je zorgt ervoor dat medewerkers optimaal kunnen functioneren en kwalitatieve zorg kunnen bieden.  Jouw belangrijkste taken:  Leidinggeven in complexe situaties: Je biedt duidelijkheid, hakt knopen door en creëert een veilige en gestructureerde werkomgeving.  Verandermanagement: Je begeleidt afdelingen in transitie en zorgt voor blijvende verbeteringen in zorgkwaliteit en teamdynamiek.  Bedrijfsvoering op orde brengen: Je monitort en rapporteert maandelijks over financiën, medewerkerstevredenheid en verloop.  Samenwerking versterken: Je betrekt vrijwilligers, mantelzorgers en familieleden bij het welzijn van cliënten.  Coachen en inspireren: Je helpt de collega’s op de locatie groeien, zodat zij hun werk met plezier en vertrouwen kunnen doen.  Wat krijg je van ons?   Bij Cordaan krijg je de kans om impact te maken binnen een kleurrijke organisatie die de ambitie heeft de beste zorgverlener en zorgwerkgever van Amsterdam te zijn. Voor deze functie zijn de arbeidsvoorwaarden conform cao VVT:  Een jaarcontract ( 32 - 36 uur per week ) met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband;  Salaris conform CAO VVT FWG 60: min. € 4.157 en max. € 6.171 bruto  (o.b.v. 36 uur per week);  Extra’s : Eindejaarsuitkering (8,33%) en vakantiegeld (8%);  Reiskosten: een vergoeding á € 0,21 per km en een fietsplan;  Pensioenopbouw via Pensioenfonds Zorg & Welzijn;    Ontwikkelmogelijkheden : Volop mogelijkheden om je persoonlijk en professioneel te ontwikkelen;   Collega aandragen? Ontvang in totaal een aanbrengbonus van € 500,- netto. Wie ben jij?   Jij bent een manager met een sterke persoonlijkheid en ruime ervaring in crisis- en verandermanagement in de zorg. Je kan projectmatig werken en weet hoe je teams motiveert en veranderingen succesvol implementeert.  Verder heb je:  Minimaal 5 jaar werkervaring als leidinggevende;  Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding in zorgmanagement, bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare richting én een aanvullende cursus of opleiding gevolgd op het gebied van verander- en/of crisismanagement;  Ervaring met begeleiding van meerdere verander- of crisismanagement trajecten in de zorg;  Aantoonbare beheersing van minimaal 3 van de volgende competenties (blijkend uit recente talentenscan of 360⁰ feedback): resultaatgerichtheid, visie, verandermanagement en beïnvloedingskracht.  Waar ga je werken?   Als interim manager kun je ingezet worden binnen een van de verschillende zorgdomeinen van Cordaan in Amsterdam in de ouderenzorg, Jeugd, GGZ en gehandicaptenzorg. Je wordt flexibel ingezet op locaties waar tijdelijke versterking nodig is, zodat jij impact kunt maken waar het écht telt.  Enthousiast? jobs.description: As Optics11 continues to grow, we are looking for a Senior Mechanical Engineer – Hardware Design to take ownership of the mechanical hardware development of high-performance fiber-optic measurement systems used in demanding energy and marine environments. At Optics11, we develop cutting-edge fiber-optic sensing solutions that make critical infrastructure and underwater security systems smarter, safer, and more reliable. In this role, you will design ruggedized chassis, enclosures, and mechanical assemblies that protect and integrate electronic, photonic, fiber-optic, and electromechanical subsystems. You will work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams and external partners to develop robust, manufacturable, and serviceable hardware solutions that support integration, qualification, manufacturing, and long-term operation. You will apply structured engineering methods, sound technical judgement, and rigorous verification practices to ensure products perform reliably under vibration, shock, thermal, EMC, ingress protection, and other environmental conditions. What you'll do: Lead the mechanical design and development of chassis, enclosures, mounting structures, and assemblies for fiber-optic measurement systems, from concept through qualification and release. Collaborate with electronics, photonics, optical, and systems engineering teams to define PCB placement, optical component integration, fiber routing, interconnections, thermal interfaces, and packaging constraints. Design robust hardware solutions that meet vibration, shock, thermal, EMC, ingress protection, environmental, serviceability, and lifecycle requirements for energy and marine applications. Develop modular, maintainable, and upgradeable hardware architectures that support manufacturability, serviceability, and long-term product support. Create and maintain engineering documentation, including drawings, specifications, design calculations, assembly instructions, and manufacturing documentation. Manage technical collaboration with suppliers, manufacturers, OEMs, and external development partners to ensure performance, quality, manufacturability, and qualification requirements are met. Support prototype development, subsystem integration, environmental and mechanical testing, product qualification, and release activities. Analyze test results, performance margins, failure modes, and operational limits to improve product robustness, reliability, and design maturity. Apply engineering analyses, trade-off studies, DfMA principles, simulation tools, and FEA to optimize mechanical, thermal, structural, dynamic, manufacturability, lifecycle, and cost performance. Investigate qualification failures, manufacturing issues, integration challenges, and field performance topics using structured problem-solving and root cause analysis. Provide technical input during design reviews, engineering discussions, development decisions, and cross-functional integration activities. Als stagiair AI & Automatisering ben je de rechterhand van de specialist voor IT en automatisering. Je onderzoekt bestaande processen, denkt mee over verbeteringen en helpt bij het ontwikkelen van nieuwe tools. Je krijgt veel ruimte om zelf ideeën uit te werken en leert tijdens deze stage ontzettend veel over AI, technologie en automatisering. Wat ga je leren? AI en automatisering inzetten in de praktijk; Zelf slimme tools en oplossingen ontwikkelen; Bestaande processen verbeteren en efficiënter maken; Werken met verschillende AI-tools en technologieën; Ervaring opdoen met echte projecten binnen een groeiend bedrijf; Je eigen ideeën uitwerken en veel nieuwe vaardigheden ontwikkelen. Praktisch Startdatum: in overleg; Beschikbaarheid: 3–5 dagen per week, in te richten rond je studierooster; Locatie: kantoor in hartje Amsterdam; Stagevergoeding: €500 per maand bij 5 dagen per week. Dit bieden wij Een uitdagende en leerzame stage waarin je écht meedraait in het team; Intensieve begeleiding door een ervaren IT-specialist, met ruimte voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling; Een centraal gelegen kantoor op ca. 15 minuten lopen van Amsterdam Centraal; Een gezellige werksfeer en een heerlijke, verzorgde lunch op kantoor; Legendarische vrijdagmiddagborrels, sportieve uitjes en bedrijfsfeesten; 25% personeelskorting op rondvaarten en andere activiteiten binnen Flagship Holding; De mogelijkheid om je stage af te sluiten met een concrete showcase- of portfolio-project. Functievereisten Je volgt een HBO- of WO-opleiding in bijvoorbeeld AI, ICT, Informatica, Business IT of een vergelijkbare richting; Ervaring met API-koppelingen en databases is mooi meegenomen; Je hebt basiskennis van programmeren en vindt het leuk om hierin verder te leren; Zelfstandig werken gaat je goed af en je neemt graag zelf initiatief; Je kunt goed communiceren in het Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Over Flagship Flagship Amsterdam is een jonge en snelgroeiende rederij in het hart van Amsterdam. Wat in 2017 begon met drie boten, is inmiddels uitgegroeid tot een vloot van meer dan 70 boten, en we groeien nog steeds elke dag verder! Jaarlijks verwelkomen we gasten uit meer dan 55 verschillende landen, en we varen het hele jaar door. Dit doen we met een gedreven en ambitieus team van meer dan 800 (seizoensgebonden) medewerkers. Maar Flagship is meer dan alleen rondvaarten. Vanuit dezelfde energie bouwen we aan verschillende concepten die allemaal draaien om beleving, gastvrijheid en de stad Amsterdam. Zo ontdek je de stad op de fiets met Flagship Bike Tours, proef je de sfeer bij Flagship Waffle Experience Amsterdam, en werken we bij Shipyard aan unieke events en creatieve projecten op en rond het water. Daarnaast hebben we labels zoals Voyage Amsterdam, Captain Jack en Aemstelland, elk met hun eigen stijl en doelgroep. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Als Senior Machine Learning Engineer bij BigData Republic combineer je diepgaande technische expertise met consultancy. Je ontwikkelt niet alleen machine-learningoplossingen, maar brengt ze daadwerkelijk naar productie en adviseert klanten over architectuur, technologie en de beste aanpak om duurzame businesswaarde te realiseren. Voor deze senior positie zoeken we een ervaren professional met minimaal 6 jaar relevante werkervaring, waarvan minimaal 3 jaar hands-on ervaring met machine learning in professionele productieomgevingen. Wat ga je doen? Machine Learning Engineering bevindt zich bij BigData Republic op het snijvlak van Machine Learning, MLOps, Software Engineering, Data Engineering en Cloud Engineering. Je werkt in multidisciplinaire teams bij klanten aan end-to-end machine-learningoplossingen: van probleemdefinitie en architectuur tot ontwikkeling, deployment, monitoring en optimalisatie. Je; analyseert complexe business- en technische vraagstukken en vertaalt deze naar robuuste ML-oplossingen; adviseert klanten en stakeholders over machine learning, MLOps, architectuur en technische keuzes; ontwikkelt en productionaliseert machine-learningmodellen; ontwerpt schaalbare ML- en MLOps-architecturen; bouwt production-grade software rondom machine-learningoplossingen; werkt aan deployment, CI/CD, model serving, monitoring en observability; werkt samen met Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Software Engineers en Cloud Engineers; helpt klanten en collega's inhoudelijk naar een hoger niveau; draagt actief bij aan kennisdeling en thought leadership binnen BigData Republic. De technische uitdagingen variëren van machine-learningmodellen met directe businessimpact tot toepassingen rond deep learning, generative AI, Large Language Models (LLM's), predictive modelling, causal inference en reinforcement learning. Bij BigData Republic zien we een machine-learningmodel niet als het eindproduct. Een model levert pas waarde wanneer het betrouwbaar, schaalbaar en beheersbaar in productie draait. Daarom benaderen we ML-oplossingen als volwaardige softwareproducten. Technologieën waarmee we veel werken zijn onder andere; Python Airflow Apache Spark Kafka Docker Tensorflow Pytorch Kubernetes Terraform AWS/ Azur/ GCP en private-cloud omgevingen Welke technologie je inzet, hangt af van het vraagstuk. Our remote-first, global team develop open-source software that anyone can use or improve. You’ll work remotely and flexibly, while still getting to meet your team mates throughout the year at team and company-wide retreats.
