Contract negotiation: Lead commercial negotiations, evaluate bids, and structure deals that manage risk while getting the best performance. End-to-end procurement operations: Oversee the whole process from requisition to delivery, in line with internal policies. Tool and process ownership: Improve procurement systems, databases and automation. Cross-functional collaboration: Be the strategic link between engineering, finance and operations. R&D support: Bring procurement input into early product development and prototyping. WHO YOU ARE Education: Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management or a related technical field. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers. lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months. As part of the dwpbank group, we’re adding a layer of resources and expertise to benefit from, while continuing to operate as an independent fintech with our own team, product, and start-up identity under the dwpbank umbrella. Your Mission: As a Backend Engineer at lemon.markets, you will play an important role in designing the backend services and architecture of our brokerage API platform that allows other companies to easily embed investing into their product. You will independently build and deliver high-quality features and services within a cross-functional team, from implementation through production. You will take ownership of your team’s deliverables, make thoughtful implementation choices based on product context and customer needs, and help ensure that the systems you work on are reliable, maintainable and ready to scale. You will work in one of our product domains: Customer Lifecycle, Investing or Banking processes, helping us maintain and improve the Core Platform & Systems around them. Our tech stack is Python, FastAPI, AWS and Postgres. In this role, you will make a meaningful contribution to the development of our core Platform & Systems and to the technical decisions within your team. You will work alongside a cross-functional team of experts as we build the investment infrastructure for the next 100 million retail investors in Europe. About you: You write well-structured, maintainable and well-tested code in at least one modern programming language, such as Python , Go, Java, Ruby, JavaScript or TypeScript. We’re technology agnostic, so Python experience isn’t required, but you should be excited to learn it. You have experience in designing and implementing highly scalable architecture and reliable REST APIs and bring the desire to make them world-class. You’ve gained good experience with software in a cloud environment ( AWS , GCP, Azure) and the architectural patterns for this environment. You have a good understanding of any of these document-based or relational database technology such as MySQL/ PostgreSQL . You know how to write high-quality code that is understandable, maintainable and well tested, and can guide other engineers to do the same via code reviews. you're embracing AI tooling and are actively incorporating it into your daily workflow You have good problem-solving skills and the ability to provide in-depth evaluations and analyses of unique and complex technological issues. You have a track record of designing, building and operating reliable and scalable backend systems as part of a cross-functional team. You will be successful in this role if: Growing investment opportunities excites you. We operate in a highly regulated environment and therefore having worked prior in a Fintech or financial Service provider would give you a head start, but is not a must. You see yourself as a product engineer. That means, you are excited by solving customer problems and strive to become an expert in the domain area you are working in. You enjoy building from scratch. This means high involvement in the product development process itself while advocating for the best engineering practices. It also means that you enjoy taking technical decisions. You are ready and willing to take ownership of problems and act on them decisively with no supervision. You always thrive

jobs.description: About Zelara Most CRM marketing still blasts generic messages at scale and calls it "personalization." Our founders experienced this firsthand in senior roles at HelloFresh, Salesforce, Uber, and others. Backed by top-tier VCs, they decided to build a better way. Zelara is an agentic lifecycle marketing platform that improves with every interaction. It works with the CRM infrastructure our customers already use, replacing static journeys and manual segmentation with a system that creates content, makes individual-level decisions, and learns from every outcome. With bunq, Europe's second-largest neobank, we delivered +7.4% activation and +66% reactivation uplift, measured against a control group. We raised a €3M pre-seed and are generating revenue with paying enterprise customers. We are growing our Solutions Architecture team to make the path from integration to measurable value repeatable across more customers. The Role This is a deeply technical customer role centered on post-sales value realization, with involvement in pre-sales discovery. It is not reactive customer success, nor a pre-sales role that hands off at signature. You own technical value realization for a portfolio of customers, from discovery and onboarding through live experiments, measured results, and scaled adoption. You and the commercial lead run each account as a pair. They own pricing, contracts, expansion, and renewal. You own the technical plan and the evidence behind those decisions: before signature you lead technical discovery alongside them, after signature you are the customer's named technical lead for solution design, data mapping, the experiment plan, and go-live. There is no separate customer success manager; the two of you hold the whole relationship. Product, Engineering, and Science own the platform, the integrations, and the measurement standards. You turn their work into a working customer solution and bring them in when a requirement crosses those lines. Our customers are mid-market and enterprise B2C companies across Europe: fintech, e-commerce, travel, and employee benefits. jobs.description: Wir suchen eine:n Business Development Manager:in für unseren Standort in München, der/die aktiv neue Kund:innen gewinnt und das Wachstum von Nelly konsequent vorantreibt. Was dich in der Rolle als Business Development Manager:in erwartet: Als Business Development Manager:in qualifizierst du neue Leads, sprichst gezielt Entscheider:innen an und führst den Sales-Prozess von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme bis zum Abschluss. Du erkennst Wachstumspotenziale frühzeitig, arbeitest zielorientiert an Abschlüssen und bringst Markt- und Kundenfeedback in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing, Customer Success und Product ein. Über Nelly Wir bauen das AI-Driven Financial Operating System für das europäische Gesundheitswesen und lösen so die größten Herausforderungen für Patient:innen und Praxen. Damit schaffen wir, was keine Bank oder Softwareplattform bewältigen kann. Unsere All-In-One Plattform verwandelt chaotische administrative Prozesse in intelligente, automatisierte Arbeitsabläufe, von der Patientenbetreuung über die Abrechnung bis hin zu Zahlungen der nächsten Generation. Denn wir sind davon überzeugt: Das Gesundheitswesen sollte weniger mit Papierkram und mehr mit Menschen zu tun haben. Warum? Europa ist mit einem massiven Mangel an medizinischen Fachkräften konfrontiert. Wenn wir die Arbeitsweise von Praxen nicht überdenken, wird das System nicht mithalten können. Mit unserer Series B Finanzierung in Höhe von über 50 Millionen Euro von Weltklasse-Investoren setzen wir unsere Vision in die Tat um. Was uns ausmacht: Wir arbeiten mit dem besten Team und geben gemeinsam jeden Tag alles. Wir setzen auf Talent Density, weil außergewöhnliche Menschen alle um sie herum besser machen. Bei Nelly bewegen wir uns schnell und erwarten, dass alle mithalten. Stillstand ist keine Option, deshalb investieren wir stark in Weiterentwicklung. KI ist bei uns kein Nice-to-have. Wir erwarten, dass du sie täglich nutzt und geben dir alle Möglichkeiten, dies zu tun. Du bekommst Vertrauen und Verantwortung, dafür erwarten wir, dass du Dinge ansprichst, auch wenn es unbequem ist. Kaltakquise), Pitch & Demo bis hin zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss übernimmst du den gesamten Sales-Funnel. Du berätst medizinische Einrichtungen auf Augenhöhe : Du verstehst ihre Herausforderungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit ihnen die passende Lösung aus unserem Produktportfolio. Du führst souveräne Verhandlungen : Ob Praxisinhaber:in, Ärzt:innen oder Verwaltungsleitung – du überzeugst verschiedene Entscheidungsträger:innen mit Empathie, Klarheit und Verhandlungsgeschick. KPI-getriebenes Arbeiten: Du arbeitest datenbasiert, steuerst deinen Funnel effizient und behältst deine Ziele und Kennzahlen stets im Blick Das bringst du mit: Erste Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb , idealerweise im SaaS- oder FinTech-Bereich – oder du überzeugst uns mit deinem Drive und Lernhunger . Keine Scheu vor Kaltakquise : Du gehst proaktiv auf Menschen zu und siehst in jedem Gespräch die Chance, echten Mehrwert zu schaffen. Motivation, Disziplin und Resilienz zeichnen dich aus – du bleibst dran, auch wenn es mal herausfordernd wird. Neugier & Struktur : Du stellst gezielte Fragen, um die Bedürfnisse deiner Gesprächspartner:innen wirklich zu verstehen, und gehst systematisch vor. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description: About us Zenjob is an AI-powered flexible staffing platform that has connected companies and temporary workers since 2015. Companies use our platform to book ready-to-work staff in real time, while students use our app - we call them Zenjobbers - to find part-time jobs that conveniently fit around their studies. Over 40,000 Zenjobbers and 1,000 partner companies from logistics, retail, and hospitality in all major German cities share our belief that good work is not a coincidence. It is the result of innovative technology and genuine commitment. Good work starts here. The Role We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Product Manager to join our team. In this role, you will play a key part in defining and executing a product vision that ensures Zenjob’s marketplace dynamics are well balanced, by optimizing our demand forecast, making sure jobs and Zenjobbers are matched optimally, and engaging students in working a high number of shifts. This is not a role that owns one squad's backlog. You'll work project-based: form a team around a problem, own it end-to-end until it delivers on the expected need. You'll get problem statements, not requirements documents. Recent examples: how shifts get allocated across thousands of Zenjobbers each week, and how we get a new Zenjobber from signup to their first shift without human intervention. This role suits a Product Manager who is energised by an open-ended problem, and who finds complex workflows genuinely interesting. You'll report to the Director of Product and work across our Supply, Demand and Staffing squads, depending on the problem to solve. What You’ll do Bring our business goals to reality. Understand our financial goals, our users' problems and transform them into solutions that drive our revenue up. Talk to users directly . Zenjobbers, clients, and our own internal teams. Most of the good opportunities come out of these conversations, not out of a backlog. Do your own data work . You don’t wait until a data analyst gives you the insights, you dive into it and derive them yourself. Turn ambiguity into a defensible plan . Take a problem nobody agrees on yet, and define what we're solving, what we're explicitly not solving, and in what order. Design and run tests . Form a hypothesis, define what would falsify it, ship the smallest thing that gives you a real answer, and be honest about the result. Drive product development from concept to launch . Pull together Engineering, Design, Ops and Commercial around a problem and keep them moving through hypothesis, building, rollout and post-launch decision making Own the outcome, not the output . Each project has a number attached. You define what success looks like up front, and you're the one who says whether it was hit. Communicate clearly. A one-page memo an exec can act on. A spec an engineer doesn't have to interpret. A tradeoff explained to Commercial in terms they care about. What we’re looking for 6+ years in product, with meaningful time on products where the software coordinates real-world processes - staffing, logistics, fintech ops, healthcare, or similar, with substantial business impact. You have experience in marketplace dynamics and allocation problems. You've shipped something complex end-to-end and can talk credibly about what broke, not just what launched. You're analytically strong - comfortable getting to an answer yourself rather than commissioning one, and having a fluent conversation with data scientists. You've moved teams you don't manage . Cross-functional influence without formal authority is most of this job. You write and speak clearly. This is the strongest single signal we look for, because in a cross-team role, clear communication is most of how work actually moves. AI is already part of how you work , and you can say specifically where it helps and where it doesn't, and you are already able to ship small features with little to no help from Engineers English fluency. jobs.title: Senior HW Engineer – PCB Layout
jobs.description: The Opportunity Lumai's optical engine only works if the electronics around it hold up. Our boards carry large FPGAs and custom ASICs, multi-gigabit links and fine-pitch packages, and they have to be laid out to tolerances that leave no room for guesswork. This role takes the designs coming out of our hardware and SI/PI teams and turns them into manufacturable, high-layer-count boards. The Role You will own board layout from schematic handoff to fabrication release. That covers stackups and HDI structures, controlled-impedance routing, differential pairs, length and phase matching, BGA breakout for large fine-pitch devices, and the full manufacturing package: Gerber/ODB++, drill files, assembly drawings and fabrication notes. You will also own the footprint and symbol libraries, the design rules and the CAD standards the rest of the team works to. What is genuinely hard about it is that the constraints are real and they conflict. Signal integrity, power integrity, thermal and mechanical requirements all land on the same square centimetres, and the fabricator's process limits decide what is actually buildable. You will be the person who turns simulation output into layout rules and who can defend a stackup to a fabricator. By month six, you will have taken at least one board through to fabrication release, set the libraries and design rules the team works from, and be the first point of contact for our fabricators and assembly houses. What You'll Do Lay out dense, high-layer-count PCBs from schematic through to fabrication release, using constraint-driven flows. Implement controlled-impedance routing, differential pair and length/phase matching, and HDI structures including microvias, via-in-pad and back-drilling. Plan BGA breakout and component placement for large FPGAs, custom ASICs and fine-pitch packages, balancing SI, PI, thermal and mechanical requirements. Translate SI/PI and hardware constraints into layout rules, and iterate quickly with engineers on simulation feedback. Run DFM, DFA and DFT reviews, and act as the main technical contact with PCB fabricators and assembly houses. Generate complete manufacturing outputs (Gerber/ODB++, drill files, assembly drawings, fabrication notes) and manage design revisions. Own and maintain the footprint and symbol libraries, CAD standards and design templates, compliant with IPC standards. What We're Looking For Must-have Extensive professional experience laying out complex, high-speed, high-layer-count boards, with a portfolio of designs that went into production. Expert proficiency in Cadence Allegro, including Constraint Manager. Equivalent Altium experience will also be considered. Hands-on experience with HDI technologies: microvias, via-in-pad, stacked and staggered vias, and back-drilling. Proven BGA breakout and placement for large, fine-pitch devices such as FPGAs and ASICs. Thorough working knowledge of IPC standards (IPC-2221, IPC-7351, IPC-6012) and of DFM/DFA/DFT principles. Strong preference for Boards carrying 56G+ SerDes, PCIe Gen5/6 or DDR5 interfaces. Working closely with SI/PI simulation engineers. Rigid-flex, RF or mixed-signal layouts. ECAD/MCAD collaboration on thermal and mechanical integration. Experience setting up CAD standards, libraries and design templates in a growing team. About Lumai Lumai is the optical compute company building the next generation of AI infrastructure. Spun out of optics research at the University of Oxford in 2021, we compute with light instead of electrons. Our 3D optical technology carries out the matrix multiplications at the heart of AI inside beams of light travelling through free space, which lets it go beyond the limits of both silicon GPUs and integrated photonics. In April 2026 we launched Iris Nova, the world's first optical computing system to run billion-parameter large language models in real time, using up to 90% less energy than conventional GPU-based systems. jobs.description: About Kernel Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this? Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier. Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust. Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. jobs.title: Medical Lead
jobs.description: Are you an experienced doctor with a passion for developing others and delivering exceptional patient care? At Montu, we are looking for a Medical Team Lead to join our growing Clinical team, combining clinical practice with the opportunity to lead, mentor and develop a team of doctors. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys supporting others, has experience providing clinical guidance and supervision, and is confident in building strong working relationships with clinicians and consultants. You will play a key role in supporting the professional development of our Junior Clinical Fellows (JCFs), helping them build confidence, develop greater clinical autonomy and deliver safe, high-quality patient care. As we continue to grow, this is an opportunity to bring your clinical expertise and leadership skills into an evolving area of healthcare, helping to shape and support the next generation of clinicians while making a meaningful difference to patients' lives. What is the job? As a Medical Team Lead, you will provide day-to-day leadership, support and guidance to a team of clinicians, ensuring they are well-supervised, well-supported, and progressing safely towards greater clinical autonomy. You will act as the primary link between clinicians and consultants, coordinating supervision, escalation pathways, and feedback loops so that patient care stays safe and consistent. You will combine your own clinical practice with people leadership, taking ownership of fellow development, consultant engagement, governance, and training within your team, while working alongside other Team Leads to keep standards consistent across the wider service. You will be the first point of contact for JCF’s requiring guidance on professional or personal development and appraisal or revalidation. You will also act as a trusted contact for consultants raising concerns about supervision and workload. What will you be doing? Support clinicians through complaints, incidents, and governance issues involving their clinical decisions. Provide direct clinical mentoring, and know when to route a case to a consultant. Promote safe prescribing and adherence to clinical standards appropriate to clinicians’ training level. Governance, Quality & Audit Support compliance with clinical policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements across the fellow cohort. Support clinical audits and quality improvement projects, involving clinicians in QI work as a development opportunity. Analyse audit and incident theme

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, ML Platform
jobs.description: The Senior Machine Learning Engineer, ML Platform is responsible for building, running, and evolving the ML monorepo used by the X-ray, CT, and MRI machine learning group at DeepHealth. The monorepo covers the full path from experimentation to product: dataset and sample definitions, training and evaluation code, experiment tracking, model export, and the inference servers that run in production. Everyone on the team contributes to the monorepo; this role is the single point of accountability for it. This hands-on role owns the architecture, tooling, and engineering standards of that codebase for a distributed team of about twenty machine learning engineers and scientists, working with model developers and software engineers to make the team’s work fast, better, and easier to audit. It also leads the team's agentic coding strategy, shaping how AI coding agents are used across the codebase. The role reports to the Leader of the ML for X-ray/CT/MRI group. Essential Duties and Responsibilities   Own the architecture and roadmap of the ML Monorepo: Module boundaries, shared abstractions for datasets and samples, training and evaluation loops, configuration, and experiment tracking. Build and run the engineering tooling around the codebase: Continuous integration, testing, dependency management, containers, artifact and model registries, and GPU job scheduling on cloud (GCP) and HPC infrastructure. Own the path from trained checkpoint to deployable model: Model packaging, inference servers with enforced API contracts, reproducibility, and performance and memory budgets on target hardware. Define and enforce engineering standards (code review, testing, documentation) in a way that accelerates research rather than slowing it down. Ensure traceability of data, code, and model versions across experiments and releases. Investigate and resolve performance, reliability, and usability issues in the stack raised by the team and reduce their recurrence through shared tooling. Drive the team's agentic coding strategy: define how AI coding agents are used in the monorepo, set up the tooling, guardrails, and conventions that make them effective, and help colleagues adopt them. Review code, mentor colleagues on engineering practices, and communicate technical decisions and trade-offs clearly. PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above.  Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time. Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience  Master's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience (required). 5+ years of software engineering experience, including a significant portion building infrastructure or tooling used by machine learning teams, such as an ML platform or a training framework (required). Strong Python skills and software engineering fundamentals: API design, testing, refactoring, and attention to developer experience (required). Solid PyTorch knowledge and practical experience with model training and profiling (required). Experience running ML workloads on a cloud platform, ideally GCP (Vertex AI, Artifact Registry, IAM, storage), and with containerization (required). Experience taking models to production: model packaging, inference serving, and performance and reliability constraints (required). Ability to work closely with researchers, translate recurring pain points into shared tooling, and push back constructively when needed (required). Ability to work autonomously in a distributed, multi-site team, with clear verbal and written communication in English (required). Medical imaging experience (DICOM, 3D volumes, large images) (preferred). HPC and Slurm experience (preferred). Contributions to open-source ML tooling (preferred). jobs.title: Chef d'équipe logistique (H/F)
jobs.description: <h2>En bref</h2> <p>Picnic grandit vite, et notre centre de préparation de commandes de Moissy-Cramayel a besoin de pilotes pour porter cette ambition. En tant que Captain, tu n'es pas juste un(e) chef(fe) d'équipe : tu es le moteur de l'entrepôt. Ton défi ? Manager environ 20 Shoppers (préparateur(rice)s de commandes) en direct, garantir une sécurité totale et transformer chaque shift en succès collectif avec +100 Shoppers sur le terrain. Si tu aimes l'action et que tu sais fédérer une équipe dans la bonne humeur, ce rôle est pour toi.</p> <h2>Tes missions</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Manager et coacher ton équipe</strong> : Tu supervises une vingtaine de Shoppers au quotidien, en veillant à leur motivation, leur sécurité et au respect des bonnes pratiques.</li> <li><strong>Piloter la performance</strong> : Tu garantis que chaque commande est prête, complète et à l'heure, en suivant de près nos indicateurs de qualité.</li> <li><strong>Coordonner les flux du FC</strong> : Tu travailles main dans la main avec les autres Captains pour fluidifier les opérations et ajuster les ressources en temps réel.</li> <li><strong>Assurer la polyvalence opérationnelle</strong> : Réception, gestion des stocks (sec, frais, surgelé) ou départ des camions... tu navigues entre les zones selon les besoins du planning.</li> <li><strong>Gérer l'humain et le terrain</strong> : Tu es le point de contact privilégié pour ton équipe, capable de recadrer avec pédagogie comme de féliciter les réussites.</li> </ul> <h2>À propos de toi</h2> <ul> <li>Tu as entre 1 et 5 ans d'expérience dans un environnement dynamique (logistique, retail, restauration ou ligne de production) avec une première gestion d'équipe réussie.</li> <li>Tu es disponible à temps plein sur des shifts tournants (matin dès 3h50 ou après-midi jusqu'à 23h30) et tu es prêt(e) à travailler les samedis.&nbsp;</li> <li>Tu maîtrises le français (l'anglais est un plus) et tu es parfaitement à l'aise avec les outils digitaux de pilotage.</li> <li>Tu es véhiculé(e) pour rejoindre facilement l'entrepôt de Moissy-Cramayel.</li> <li>Tu n'as pas peur de mettre la main à la pâte. Tu aimes l'action et tu sais prendre des décisions rapides pour débloquer des situations opérationnelles.</li> </ul> <h2>Avantages Picnic&nbsp;</h2> <p>🍴 <strong>Restauration&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Dans ton FC, tu disposeras d’une variété de déjeuners, de dîners, de snacks et de boissons sains, préparés fraîchement sur place par notre chef !</p> <p><strong>🎫 Sorties et divertissement</strong></p> <p>Un accès à des offres et avantages exclusifs via notre CSE et partenaire Swile (bons d'achats, places de concert, cinéma, et plus encore). Tu seras aussi convié(e) à nos événements récurrents comme notre très convoitée Summer Party !</p> <p><strong>👨‍⚕️ Santé et repos</strong></p> <p>Grâce à nos partenariats avec SideCare et OpenUp, tu as la possibilité de souscrire à notre mutuelle d’entreprise ainsi qu’à un accès facile et gratuit à des psychologues professionnels, des ateliers et des outils pratiques. De plus, tu disposeras de 25 jours de congés payés par an.</p> <p><strong>✍️ Développement personnel et professionnel</strong></p> <p>Tu auras l’opportunité de développer tes compétences, non seulement au travers de projets stimulants, mais aussi grâce à des formations dédiées au leadership.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/FSwRUFqnISA" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p&gt

jobs.description: <p class="isSelectedEnd"></p> <h2 data-pm-slice="1 1 []">Description de l'équipe</h2> <p>SumUp accélère le déploiement de ses équipes de vente terrain en France, et ce poste à responsabilité façonnera cette croissance à Toulouse, en apportant nos outils de paiement et de gestion aux petites entreprises de la région. La personne retenue dirigera et développera une équipe de consultants commerciaux terrain indépendants, en assurant personnellement des acquisitions dans un premier temps tout en construisant la structure, la culture et le modèle de coaching qui porteront la région. C'est l'occasion de construire une région depuis ses fondations, avec une évolution possible vers un poste de Territory Manager à mesure que l'équipe et l'activité se développent, en rapportant au Head of Region France.</p> <h2>Vos missions</h2> <ul> <li> <p>Diriger et développer une équipe de consultants commerciaux terrain indépendants, en construisant les compétences et la culture sur le terrain, réaliser des audits auprès des marchands et transformer la connaissance du marché en actions concrètes</p> </li> <li> <p>Définir la stratégie concurrentielle de la région et tenir les parties prenantes seniors informées de l'avancement</p> </li> </ul> <h2>Vous êtes fait pour ce poste si…</h2> <ul> <li> <p>Expérience avérée dans la direction et le développement d'équipes commerciales, incluant le coaching de consultants indépendants vers une performance durable</p> </li> <li> <p>Expérience dans la construction d'une région ou d'un territoire commercial dès ses débuts, prenantes variées</p> </li> <li> <p>Prise de décision stratégique et orientée données, avec la capacité à diriger dans l'incertitude d'un marché en forte croissance</p> </li> </ul> <h2>Pourquoi rejoindre SumUp</h2> <p>🌎 Opportunité de travailler avec des SumUppers du monde entier sur des produits fintech à grande échelle utilisés par des millions d'entreprises, dans le cadre d'un poste de terrain couvrant la région de Toulouse. jobs.description: <h1>Conseiller(ère) commercial(e) terrain expérimenté(e)&nbsp;</h1> <p>Indépendant | Rémunération à la commission uniquement | Territoire de vente local | Commissions déplafonnées</p> <h2>À propos de l’opportunité</h2> <p>Nous recherchons des commerciaux terrain expérimentés, à l’aise pour se rendre dans une entreprise, engager la conversation avec le propriétaire et convaincre de nouveaux commerçants.</p> <p>En tant que conseiller commercial itinérant indépendant, vous vendrez les solutions de paiement, de point de vente et logicielles de SumUp aux petites et moyennes entreprises de votre région. Vous identifierez vous-même vos prospects, gérerez votre portefeuille d’opportunités et accompagnerez les clients lors de leur mise en route.</p> <p>Vous devrez justifier d’une expérience en prospection à froid et apprécier la vente en face à face sur le terrain. Vous gérerez votre propre activité et organiserez vos démarches commerciales de manière autonome, tout en bénéficiant de la formation et du soutien de SumUp.</p> <h2>Vos missions</h2> <ul> <li> <p>Trouver de nouveaux clients grâce à des visites en face à face, de la prospection en porte-à-porte et des démarches directes.</p> </li> <li> <p>Cibler les entreprises locales générant d’importants volumes de paiement et susceptibles de tirer parti des produits SumUp.</p> </li> <li> <p>Poser des questions sur le fonctionnement de chaque entreprise et recommander des solutions adaptées en matière de paiement, de matériel, de caisse et de logiciels.</p> </li> <li> <p>Gérer le processus de vente depuis le premier échange, en passant par les démonstrations de produits, la gestion des objections et la conclusion, dans le cadre du partenariat.</p> </li> <li> <p>Aider les clients à mettre en place et à commencer à utiliser leurs produits SumUp.</p> </li> <li> <p>Établir des relations avec les chefs d’entreprise et demander des recommandations aux clients satisfaits.</p> </li> <li> <p>Planifier vos visites et vos suivis afin d’optimiser votre temps sur le terrain.</p> </li> <li> <p>Suivre votre activité, vos opportunités et vos résultats de vente, et transmettre les informations nécessaires au traitement des ventes.</p> </li> <li> <p>Échanger avec votre interlocuteur SumUp pour bénéficier de son expertise produit et de conseils commerciaux.</p> </li> </ul> <h2>Ce que nous recherchons</h2> <h3>Indispensable</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Au moins un an d’expérience dans la vente sur le terrain dans des secteurs tels que les télécommunications, l’énergie, les technologies d’entreprise, la gestion des déchets, les systèmes de sécurité ou l’approvisionnement en produits alimentaires et boissons.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une expérience de la prospection à froid, notamment en démarchant des entreprises en face à face et en trouvant vos propres prospects.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une expérience de la vente auprès de petites et moyennes entreprises et des relations directes avec les propriétaires ou les décideurs.</p> </li> <li> <p>Des résultats démontrables en matière d’acquisition de nouveaux clients et d’atteinte d’objectifs commerciaux. Nous vous demanderons des exemples de vos réalisations et de la manière dont vous y êtes parvenu.</p> </li> <li> <p>La capacité à gérer un processus de vente de la première prise de contact à la conclusion, y compris la gestion des questions et des objections.</p> </li> <li> <p>Un bon sens de l’organisation et un suivi rigoureux.</p> </li> <li> <p>La capacité à gérer les refus, à tirer les leçons

jobs.title: Growth - France (CDD)
jobs.description: About Us At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, inverters and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets. We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand. We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here . France is one of the most important flexibility markets in Europe. This role is critical to accelerating Axle’s growth in France. We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the French market. This is a role that spans both sales and go to market. You’ll be responsible for both winning new partners (OEMs, utilities, platforms, etc.) and making those partnerships succeed over time. This is a multifaceted, client-facing role with a strong technical component. You will own the full commercial lifecycle and should be comfortable moving between strategic conversations, commercial negotiations, onboarding and account growth. You will speak native-level French and fluent English. Other European languages will also be an asset. jobs.title: Care Account Manager (Clinical), Europe & West Africa
jobs.description: The Role Intellect delivers a clinically governed mental health programme to enterprise clients in the mining and resources sector, supporting remote and expatriate workforces. This is not a standard EAP. Cases begin with acute risk assessment on remote sites and run through structured treatment, fitness-for-work assessment and return-to-work clearance, in direct coordination with the client's chaplaincy, medical and people teams. This role covers the client's United Kingdom operations and a West African project site where the working language is French. It is a combined clinical delivery and case management role: the postholder conducts the assessments, delivers the therapy, writes the reports and owns the case, rather than coordinating a provider network. That design reflects the absence of an established provider network in the West African market at launch, and gives the client a single clinician who knows each case end to end. Full professional fluency in French and English is a non-negotiable requirement. Welfare calls, clinical assessment, case documentation and client communication in the West African market are conducted in French. Responsibilities Clinical assessment and delivery Conduct acute risk and welfare assessments for employees referred through the client's escalation pathway, in French or English as required. Deliver individual counselling and psychotherapy across the supported caseload, virtually. Conduct fitness-for-work assessments and produce the associated clinical documentation. Write risk assessments, session documentation, return-to-work memoranda and fitness-for-work reports to a standard that stands up to client and regulatory scrutiny, in the language the case requires. Delivery is capped so that case management availability is protected. Session load is agreed with the Head of Clinical Operations and reviewed as volume changes. Case management and coordination Own each case end to end, from referral through assessment, treatment, fitness-for-work and reintegration to closure. Align the initial support plan with the client's on-site teams, including session volume and cadence, and manage adjustments where clinically indicated. Coordinate with internal helpline, care excellence and network partnership teams on anything that cannot be delivered directly. Review the open case list for stalled items and follow up to keep cases moving. Clinical risk oversight and governance Confirm risk tiering against the client's framework and set review cadence and monitoring requirements. Make the clinical decisions the pathway requires, including disputed risk ratings and medical evaluation pathways where an employee declines therapy. Escalate to the Head of Clinical Operations where a case exceeds the scope of remote delivery or requires in-person intervention. Work within the differing regulatory, medical and emergency-escalation environments of each market, and flag where local pathways do not support the agreed protocol. Clinical protocols and client enablement Co-develop and maintain the clinical protocols, risk frameworks and SOPs the client's on-site teams operate to, including French-language versions. Design and deliver clinical training and framework guidance to client-side staff who are not clinicians, in French and English. Build out the in-market provider network alongside Network Partnerships, so that in-person and overflow capacity exists as the programme scales. Client relationship, insights and reporting Act as the named clinical contact for the client's chaplaincy, medical and health and safety leads in both markets, responding within the core window to queries that are frequently unscheduled and time-critical. Produce the case tracker and monthly clinical reporting, moving beyond utilisation to presenting issues, risk patterns, outcomes and service-level themes. Present clinical insight at client review meetings and translate it into recommendations the client's health and safety and people team

Candidates with relevant crypto or financial-crime investigation experience from other backgrounds will also be considered Experience working with public-sector, law-enforcement, intelligence, or other mission-focused stakeholders Strong investigative judgement and the ability to explain findings clearly and build credibility with customers The technical aptitude to learn investigative platforms and work with data; extensive software-engineering experience is not required The ability to analyse complex information and communicate findings to both investigators and senior stakeholders The flexibility to work across pre-sales, customer delivery, and ongoing support Fluency in French, with the ability to work confidently with French-speaking customers The ability to be based in France, ideally in Paris Required Skills Technical Skills Confidence using investigative tools and the ability to develop expertise in Chainalysis Reactor Ability to work with investigative data and turn customer requirements into practical workflows, queries, and reports Familiarity with blockchain investigation tools or analytical workflows is an advantage; Python and SQL are not required Ability to learn Chainalysis products and understand how their data can support customer investigations Domain Expertise Experience in law enforcement, policing, intelligence, financial crime, or another relevant investigative field Understanding of investigative objectives, operational workflows, and the outcomes customers need to achieve Ability to use investigative judgement to guide an investigation and advise customers on their approach Customer & Communication Skills

jobs.title: Young Graduate in Data and Software Engineering (Zurich, Switzerland)
jobs.description: Who We Are Founded in 2017, Unit8 is a fast-growing Swiss AI and data analytics consulting and services company dedicated to solving complex problems of traditional industries like automotive, chemical, financial services, manufacturing and pharma. We work with some of the biggest organizations in Europe to solve the challenges that directly affect their business - be it operations, finance, manufacturing or R&D. Since our foundation, we have successfully delivered more than 300 projects and have grown to 190+ talented individuals across 10 office locations. Unit8’s mission is to drive the adoption of AI and Data Science in the non-digital industries and to help accelerate their digital transformation. Among its activities, Unit8 dedicates a part of its resources and time on projects that deeply matter to us - that includes collaboration on pro-bono and “engineering for good” causes. Requirements What You’ll Do Unit8 is welcoming young graduates for the opportunity to grow in Data and Software Engineering! Join us for a 6-month paid professional experience in building industrial Data and AI solutions. You can start asap, with direct exposure to clients' needs and opportunities to participate in learning activities such as Reading Groups and Knowledge Sharing Sessions. In addition, each young graduate will be accompanied by a dedicated wingmate/mentor who will guide and help them build their technical growth vision. As a young graduate you will join a team of Data Scientists, Data Engineers and Cloud Engineers who work hand-in-hand with our customers on designing and implementing their industry-specific use cases. You will be directly involved in discussing the client’s challenges and needs and will have chances to develop your client-facing skills. You will be responsible for developing, deploying, and automating our AI services and cloud infrastructure. You will also learn to carefully analyse a given problem and apply the relevant tools and techniques to solve it. In general you will: use software best practices in continuous integration and delivery, versioning and automation; use your skills to build and maintain service and data infrastructure; participate as junior engineer in all phases of the software development life cycle - planning, implementation, deployment, testing and maintenance; Are You the team member we are looking for? In order to be successful in this role, you are/have: motivated and eager to learn different aspects of engineering comfortable interacting with technical and business people strong communication and presentation skills recently graduated/finishing your MSc or BSc in Computer Science or related major; familiar with version control and collaboration tooling (git) familiar with CI/CD frameworks and automated deployment concepts (i.e Docker, K8s) fluent in both English and German available for a minimum of 32h a week. ready to start on the 1st of February Benefits What We Offer Exposure to a wide variety of projects, industries, and technologies. Training-on-the-job and your personal wingmate/mentor 15 paid days of holiday Be part of an international team of more than 20 nationalities. up to 10% of paid time for self-development. Flexible working hours, including some home office. Cross offices/company-wide frequent events like offsites. If you are successful, opportunity to be then hired for a permanent position. Own production deployments, managing logs, alerts, and careful rollouts with clear rollback plans. Strong passion for collaborating directly with end-users, including warehouse and operations staff, rather than exclusively with other engineers. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: Als Senior Data Engineer bij BigData Republic adviseer je toonaangevende organisaties in Nederland over complexe data-vraagstukken. Je combineert hands-on engineering met een adviserende rol: je schrijft productie-klare code, denkt mee over strategische bedrijfsbeslissingen en begeleidt collega’s om naar een hoger niveau te groeien. Je hebt je carrière opgebouwd rond het ontwerpen en bouwen van datasystemen. Je werkt graag inhoudelijk mee, maar verliest kwaliteit, schaalbaarheid en duurzaamheid nooit uit het oog. Je bent een ervaren Data Engineer die vaak moeilijk in één functie te vatten is, omdat je op meerdere niveaus impact maakt. En je bent toe aan een nieuwe uitdaging. Bij BigData Republic ontwikkelen we data-applicaties, bouwen we data-platformen, creëren we voorspellende modellen en ontwerpen we robuuste data-infrastructuren. We werken vanuit een software-engineering mindset, met focus op technische hoogstaande kwaliteit. Kennisdeling en thought leadership vormen de kern van onze cultuur. Elke vrijdag organiseren we kennissessies op kantoor, we schrijven blogs, organiseren meetups en bezoeken en spreken op conferenties. jobs.title: Senior Recruiter
jobs.description: Wij zoeken geen recruiter die wacht op sollicitaties. adesso Nederland groeit. En de mensen die wij zoeken, zijn meestal niet actief op zoek naar een nieuwe baan. Daarom zoeken we een Senior Recruiter die recruitment écht beheerst. Iemand die begrijpt dat een vacature online zetten het begin is en niet de strategie. Je weet hoe je zelf de markt in gaat. Je searcht, sourcet, benadert en bouwt relaties op. Je probeert verschillende invalshoeken als een search niet werkt. Je kent LinkedIn Recruiter, maar weet ook dat sourcing meer is dan een paar zoektermen invoeren en InMails versturen. En misschien nog belangrijker: je hebt ideeën. Over waar we talent kunnen vinden. Over hoe we mensen kunnen benaderen. Over employer branding. Over onze propositie als werkgever. Over tooling, data, events, referrals, communities en alles wat ons kan helpen om betere mensen aan adesso te verbinden. Zie je een kans? Dan verwachten we niet dat je wacht tot iemand je vertelt wat je moet doen. Je pakt hem. Wat ga je doen? Je krijgt verantwoordelijkheid voor recruitment binnen adesso Nederland en werkt nauw samen met hiring managers en management. Daarbij ben je zowel strategisch als operationeel. Want senior zijn betekent bij ons niet dat je alleen adviseert. Je doet het ook zelf. Je: voert zelfstandig searches uit naar schaarse IT-professionals; bouwt talentpools op in plaats van pas te zoeken zodra er een vacature ontstaat; benadert kandidaten persoonlijk en weet hun interesse te wekken; experimenteert met nieuwe sourcingkanalen en manieren van benaderen; voert intakes met hiring managers en durft kritisch te zijn op het profiel dat zij zoeken; adviseert over haalbaarheid, arbeidsmarkt, salaris en recruitmentstrategie; voert gesprekken met kandidaten en begeleidt het proces van eerste contact tot hire; houdt overzicht over je vacatures en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor het resultaat; gebruikt data om te begrijpen wat wel en niet werkt; komt zelf met voorstellen om recruitment slimmer en effectiever te maken; denkt mee over employer branding, referral recruitment, events en communities; bouwt mee aan hoe recruitment binnen adesso Nederland zich verder ontwikkelt. Je krijgt daarbij geen dichtgetimmerd recruitmenthandboek. We verwachten juist dat jij vanuit je ervaring kunt zeggen: “Dit werkt niet. Ik denk dat we het zo moeten aanpakken.” En vervolgens help je om het te realiseren. Wanneer ben je voor ons senior? Niet omdat er ‘Senior Recruiter’ op je LinkedIn-profiel staat. Voor ons zit senioriteit in hoe je werkt. Je hoeft niet gevraagd te worden om te sourcen je weet dat het onderdeel van je vak is. Als een search niets oplevert, concludeer je niet dat “de markt lastig is”. Je verandert je aanpak. Als een hiring manager een onrealistisch profiel zoekt, durf je dat gesprek te voeren. Als je ziet dat ons recruitmentproces beter kan, kom je niet alleen met het probleem maar ook met een voorstel. En als je een goed idee hebt, krijg je energie van het daadwerkelijk uitvoeren ervan. We zoeken iemand met stevige recruitmentervaring, bij voorkeur binnen IT, tech of consultancy. Maar het aantal jaren ervaring vinden we minder belangrijk dan wat je daadwerkelijk kunt. We willen vooral zien dat je: aantoonbaar sterk bent in search, sourcing en direct benaderen; weet hoe je schaarse senior professionals vindt en interesseert; verschillende sourcingstrategieën kunt bedenken én uitvoeren; creatief bent in het vinden van nieuwe kandidaten en doelgroepen; verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor je vacatures en resultaten; zelfstandig prioriteiten stelt; hiring managers als volwaardig gesprekspartner adviseert; kritisch durft te zijn wanneer dat nodig is; nieuwsgierig bent naar nieuwe recruitmenttechnieken, tooling en AI; met data naar je eigen recruitmentfunnel kijkt; ideeën niet alleen bedenkt, maar ook uitvoert; Nederlands en Engels professioneel beheerst. Denk aan een geweldsincident, iemand die onwel wordt of iemand die ongeoorloofd toegang probeert te krijgen. Door dit soort situaties sneller te herkennen, kan er eerder worden gereageerd. Wat ga je doen? Als Senior Data Scientist werk je aan verschillende klantvraagstukken. Soms begint dat met het onderzoeken of Machine Learning überhaupt de juiste oplossing is. In een ander project stap je in wanneer een model verder ontwikkeld of naar productie gebracht moet worden. Ook toepassingen rondom generatieve AI spelen steeds vaker een rol. Je werkt daarbij nauw samen met klanten en met collega’s uit verschillende disciplines. Work with product managers, solution architects, business analysts, data architects, and ML engineers to understand business requirements, recommend outcomes, and build best-in-class data products based on consensus. Energieausweisen oder Heizlastberechnungen Schreiben von Angeboten und Rechnungen Koordinierung & Durchführung des Sanierungssprintes Qualifikation Ein erfolgreicher Geschäftsführer im Bereich der Energieberatung sollte folgende Qualifikationen mitbringen: Interesse am Energiesektor: Kenntnisse über Immobilien, Produkte und Dienstleistungen sowie die Fähigkeit, sich in dieses Thema einzuarbeiten. jobs.title: Senior Conversion Design Analyst (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Your mission We're looking for a Senior Conversion Design Analyst who is genuinely both things: a designer who digs into data, and an analyst who designs. You decide with evidence. You will frame real user problems based on qualitative and quantitative data, design a part of our product, form a view about what should change, build the experiment that tests it, and analyze the results yourself. You will sit inside the product delivery team that focuses on user growth, working closely with the person accountable for that part of the business and with the engineers building it. And you will not be doing it alone: You join a group of Conversion Design Analysts across the company who work the same way and hold each other's standards. English is our working language. German matters here too: You will be designing flows that German-speaking users read. Concretely, you will: Design experiences grounded in real user needs and real neighbourhood life. Your job is to design flows and screens that are highly usable and intuitive and that earn their place by adding measurable value, not just because we can build them. Frame the real problem before solving it. Dig into quantitative and qualitative data until you find the actual question underneath the ask. Then make it explainable and actionable. A well-framed problem is half the battle Design, run the experiment, read it honestly and decide what comes next. Define a testable change, get it instrumented properly, and analyse the outcome. Then use what you learned to frame the next question. That includes reporting the tests that did not work, and designing the next step. Talk to neighbours. Experiments tell you what happened, not what people needed. You will spend real time with the people who use this, because you cannot A/B test your way to understanding somebody. Direct AI, and spend your judgment where it counts. AI produces a lot of our first-pass design. You will brief it, push back on it, and hold the quality bar, so your own hours go to the thinking a model cannot do. Argue for cutting things. Adding is easy. You will help decide what earns its place and what should be removed, and be willing to make the case for less. Your profile You practice product design and analytics. You might come from an analyst background and bring a love of design and design thinking, or vice versa. You have run experiments end to end and know how to move from one to the next. Setting up the hypothesis, designing strong variants using our design system, choosing the right metrics to track, analyzing the results and then making a clear call on how to continue: ship it, kill it, or iterate. You have technical know-how and experience in setting up and evaluating experiments in an A/B testing tool, constructing the needed dashboards for the problem space you are working on. With sufficient data literacy, you get your own numbers through SQL query. You work with raw data to dig up insights and spot opportunities, without waiting for someone else to pull it for you. You have statistical literacy. You don’t need to be able to run R, but you understand what Bayesian vs. frequentist is about and why you do a power analysis before launching an experiment. You care about craft and are attentive to details. You can tell the difference between good enough and actually good and you design experiences people do not have to think about. You present your work clearly, defend your decisions when challenged, and are comfortable in front of a crowd. You are fluent with AI tools. This role allows you to have more control and impact through both design and analysis, but to do this well you'll need to leverage (and at times extend) our AI enablement stack Excellent English skills for working in our international team. To apply, include a cover letter explaining why this role and why now and if your background doesn't tick every box, tell us how you'd bridge the gap. jobs.description: About Ryft Ryft is a regulated payment facilitator and authorised payment institution building the infrastructure layer for modern commerce platforms. We enable marketplaces, SaaS platforms and multi-party ecosystems to embed and monetise payments natively. Our technology handles onboarding, compliance, orchestration, split payments and revenue sharing, allowing our partners to focus on growth while we manage complexity. We are now entering the next phase of scale, expanding into new verticals and building a category-defining embedded payments platform. About the Role We’re hiring a Risk Operations Analyst to sit within our first line fraud and risk function, reporting to the Fraud & Risk Manager. This role is the operational backbone of how Ryft manages its relationships with acquiring and banking partners, taking inbound queries from our acquires and bank partners and owning them through to resolution. The core of this role is investigative. When a query comes in from a banking partner, we need someone who can trace a transaction end-to-end through our systems, understand what the bank is actually asking, produce a response that meets their expectations, and critically, question what they find along the way rather than closing the thread at the first plausible answer. Alongside partner queries, you’ll carry out merchant risk monitoring as part of the broader fraud and risk operation; reviewing merchant behaviour, flagging anomalies, and feeding intelligence into the fraud detection and response process led by the Fraud & Risk Manager. If you’re someone who digs until they have the full picture, is comfortable navigating between internal systems and external expectations, and takes pride in the quality of what they send to a bank, this role is for you. What You’ll Do Acquirer & Banking Partner Query Management • Act as the primary point of contact for inbound risk and compliance queries from Ryft’s acquiring and banking partners — managing each query through to full resolution. • Trace transactions end-to-end through Ryft’s systems in response to partner queries — reconstructing the payment journey, identifying where issues occurred, and producing clear, accurate responses that meet the bank’s expectations. • Understand what each banking partner needs to see in a response and tailor your output accordingly — whether that’s a transaction trail, a merchant explanation, supporting documentation, or a combination. • Question what you find — don’t close a query at the first plausible answer. If something looks unusual or doesn’t add up, dig further and escalate to the Fraud &amp; Risk Manager where needed. • Maintain a clear log of all partner queries, response timelines, and outcomes, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks and that patterns across queries are surfaced proactively. • Build a working knowledge of each partner’s reporting expectations, query formats, and escalation preferences, reducing friction in ongoing communications. Merchant Risk Monitoring • Carry out day-to-day merchant risk monitoring across the Ryft portfolio — reviewing transaction activity, volumes, and behavioural patterns to identify anomalies that may indicate fraud, policy breach, or elevated risk. • Feed merchant risk intelligence into the fraud detection and response process, working closely with the Fraud &amp; Risk Manager to ensure monitoring activity informs rule tuning and threshold decisions. • Flag merchants or sub-merchants exhibiting patterns of concern, documenting your findings clearly and escalating where a risk response is required. • Support chargeback and dispute monitoring at the merchant level, identifying accounts with elevated dispute rates and feeding that data into the wider fraud analysis process. • Maintain accurate, audit-ready records of monitoring activity and risk decisions in line with FCA expectations and internal policy. Cross-functional Collaboration • Work closely with the Fraud &amp; Risk

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Officer

As Leafio continues to grow, we are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Quality Officer who is passionate about maintaining high standards of quality, compliance and patient safety. This is an opportunity to be part of a business at a pivotal stage of its journey, helping to establish and develop our quality processes as we build a compliant, efficient and reliable pharmaceutical supply chain. Working closely with our Responsible Person and wider operational teams, you will play a key role in maintaining our Quality Management System, supporting regulatory compliance and ensuring that the medicines moving through our supply chain meet the highest standards. We are looking for someone who brings hands-on experience within a regulated pharmaceutical environment, a strong understanding of Good Distribution Practice (GDP) and the confidence to take ownership of quality activities in a fast-paced, evolving business. If you enjoy working collaboratively, have a keen eye for detail and want to make a meaningful contribution to a growing organisation, this could be a fantastic next step in your career. What is the job? We are looking for an experienced Quality Officer to join Leafio at a pivotal stage of our growth. This is a unique opportunity to join an ambitious team as we establish our pharmaceutical wholesale operation and secure the licences required to import, store and distribute medicinal products across the UK. As part of the Quality team, you will ensure the daily activities are actioned and monitored and meet the highest standards of Good Distribution Practice (GDP), regulatory compliance and product quality. You will play a critical role in ensuring that all medicinal products received, stored and supplied by Leafio comply with GDP, MHRA requirements (esp Reg 167), internal Quality Management Systems (QMS) standards, and customer expectations. What will you be doing? Ensure that Deviations, change controls, risk management and CAPAs are actioned according to their target date of completion Raise Deviations, change controls, risk managements and CAPAs when needed and support in the investigations where relevant Maintain and update the QMS (SOPs, policies, forms, logs) Draft standard operating procedures, distribute for reviewing and finalising the procedures Manage document control, versioning, training records and archiving Support preparation of quality management review Deliver GDP and QMS training to the relevant departments where needed Support with batch traceability, Certificate of Analysis (CoA) documentation and batch release confirmations/verifications Support with customers’ complaints and ensure timelines are adhered to Support the Responsible Person (RP) in maintaining compliance and safeguarding product quality throughout the supply chain. You will also contribute to the development of clinical pathways, support patient and staff education and play an important role in maintaining the highest standards of clinical care. jobs.title: Medical Lead
jobs.description: Are you an experienced doctor with a passion for developing others and delivering exceptional patient care? At Montu, we are looking for a Medical Team Lead to join our growing Clinical team, combining clinical practice with the opportunity to lead, mentor and develop a team of doctors. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys supporting others, has experience providing clinical guidance and supervision, and is confident in building strong working relationships with clinicians and consultants. You will play a key role in supporting the professional development of our Junior Clinical Fellows (JCFs), helping them build confidence, develop greater clinical autonomy and deliver safe, high-quality patient care. As we continue to grow, this is an opportunity to bring your clinical expertise and leadership skills into an evolving area of healthcare, helping to shape and support the next generation of clinicians while making a meaningful difference to patients' lives. What is the job? As a Medical Team Lead, you will provide day-to-day leadership, support and guidance to a team of clinicians, ensuring they are well-supervised, well-supported, and progressing safely towards greater clinical autonomy. You will act as the primary link between clinicians and consultants, coordinating supervision, escalation pathways, and feedback loops so that patient care stays safe and consistent. You will combine your own clinical practice with people leadership, taking ownership of fellow development, consultant engagement, governance, and training within your team, while working alongside other Team Leads to keep standards consistent across the wider service. You will be the first point of contact for JCF’s requiring guidance on professional or personal development and appraisal or revalidation. You will also act as a trusted contact for consultants raising concerns about supervision and workload. What will you be doing? Clinician Line Management Act as the named line manager/lead for a cohort of clinicians, providing day-to-day leadership, coaching, and pastoral support. Conduct regular 1:1s with each fellow, tracking progress against objectives, competencies, and rotation/training milestones. Identify clinicians who are struggling early, and put support plans in place in collaboration with consultants and HR/medical education leads. Assist with the onboarding and induction experience for new clinicians — inductions, shadowing, buddy systems, and early check-ins. Support the management of day-to-day workforce logistics for the clinicians: rota input, leave requests, sickness/absence, and shift coverage, working with the operations team. Recognise and celebrate good performance, and manage underperformance or conduct concerns through appropriate, documented processes alongside our HR team. Consultant Engagement Build and maintain strong working relationships with consultants. Act as the escalation point for consultants — surfacing concerns about supervision quality, caseload, or clinical support gaps. Coordinate consultant and JCF annual appraisals or revalidation. Gather and act on consultant feedback regarding clinical safety and any recurring themes. Support scheduling and coverage conversations with consultants (clinics, on-call, teaching sessions). Clinical & Patient Support Act as a point of escalation for complex clinical cases and patient concerns. Support clinicians through complaints, incidents, and governance issues involving their clinical decisions. Provide direct clinical mentoring, and know when to route a case to a consultant. Promote safe prescribing and adherence to clinical standards appropriate to clinicians’ training level. Governance, Quality & Audit Support compliance with clinical policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements across the fellow cohort. Support clinical audits and quality improvement projects, involving clinicians in QI work as a development opportunity. Analyse audit and incident theme

jobs.title: Consultant Psychiatrist PAYE
jobs.description: An opportunity to help patients who have run out of options For many people living with chronic pain, the journey has been long. They have tried multiple medications, procedures and therapies, yet their pain continues to impact every aspect of daily life. By the time they reach us, many are looking for another option where conventional treatment has fallen short. We are Montu UK, one of the UK's largest medical cannabis clinics, and we are looking for Consultants specialising in Pain Management to join our clinical team. About the role You will assess and manage patients exploring cannabis based medicines, making the clinical decision on whether treatment is appropriate and managing their care from there. This is an evolving area of medicine where the evidence base continues to grow, giving you the opportunity to help shape how cannabis based medicines are used within pain management in the UK. You do not need previous experience with cannabis based medicines. We are looking for experienced Pain Management Consultants with sound clinical judgement, an open mind and a genuine interest in improving outcomes for patients with complex chronic pain. We provide comprehensive specialist training, and our multidisciplinary model means you are never working in isolation. Nurses and pharmacists complete pre consultation and follow up prescribing tasks, allowing you to focus on clinical decision making and patient care. What you will be doing: Provide high quality care for patients seeking medical cannabis treatment. Conduct patient consultations, including assessment and ongoing management. Engage in clinical outcome data collection to support evidence based practices. Contribute to clinical governance and maintain robust patient care standards. Collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary team, including nurses and pharmacists. Participate in ongoing training and professional development, including bespoke specialist training in cannabis based medicines (CBMPs). What you need: Full GMC Registration Completion of Specialist Training (CCST/CCT) or equivalent certification On the GMC Specialist Register for Pain Demonstrated interest in alternative therapies Willingness to participate in data collection and reporting Why join us? Highly Competitive Salary: £190,000 - £275,000 FTE, pro rata for part time roles based on experience and hours worked. Flexible Working: Full time or part time options available Comprehensive Indemnity Coverage: Montu will cover all professional and clinical indemnity insurance for your work with us Private Healthcare Work-Life Balance: No night shifts or on call requirements Cutting Edge Training: Access to CPD accredited medical cannabis education and specialist in house training from industry leaders Collaborative Environment: Join a multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals Personal Growth: Be part of a pioneering field and shape the future of medical cannabis care in the UK Training & Development: Attendance at a recognised Medical Cannabis Course for Specialist Physicians (sponsored by Montu) Specialist training delivered by experts, including Prof Anup Mathew (Consultant Psychiatrist) and Dr Gerard Sinovich (Pain Management Consultant). Ongoing support and training on clinical protocols, prescribing practices, and Montu’s system usage Working arrangements: Remote Role: Flexible working hours and days Session Structure: Standard session length: 4 hours Appointment duration: 15 minutes (new and existing patients) Montu’s multidisciplinary model allows consultants to focus on prescribing and patient care, while nurses and pharmacists handle pre consultation and follow up tasks. If you are passionate about innovative patient care, thrive in a dynamic environment, and are looking to make a real impact in the field of medical cannabis, we would love to hear from you! Sessions: Each standard session consists of 4 hours of patient consultations. Clinicians can choose their preferred working days

jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 class="job-details__description-header text-color-secondary font-family-secondary" data-bind="i18n: 'job-details.employer-description-title'">About Us</h2> <div class="job-details__description-content basic-formatter" data-bind="html: pageData().job.corporateDescription"> <div>Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting &amp; Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.&nbsp;</div> </div> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><h2 data-bind="i18n: 'job-details.organization-description-title'">About the Team</h2> <p><strong>Overview&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Every time a fan places a bet, earns a reward, or checks out on Fanatics — Fanatics Core made that possible. We build the shared foundations — identity, payments, loyalty, wallet, data, and platform — that power sports betting, ecommerce, collectibles, and beyond. We supercharge the business by providing products and capabilities so that teams can focus on what matters most: building delightful experiences for the fans.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll join the Promotions Platform team within FBG. Your duties will encompass the design, implementation, testing, and maintenance of software that enables customers to engage with FBG's promotional systems. Additionally, you will contribute to backend features that allow customers to earn rewards, which can be used throughout the entire Fanatics ecosystem. We are currently focused on developing the next generation of promotional tools.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead a team or teams that develops, tests, documents, and deploys high quality software into production, leading the delivery of solutions that are extensible and scalable</li> <li>Clarify requirements and assists with coding/story estimates</li> <li>Participate in the on-call rotation when needed to troubleshoot software issues</li> <li>Quickly identify when to troubleshoot or escalate when tasks or projects hit roadblocks, find a path forward in difficult situations</li> <li>Mitigate immediate risk, identify and resolve root causes&nbsp;</li> <li>Remove bottlenecks and make technical and design approach trade-off decisions short term vs long-term</li> <li>Contribute to team planning and design discussions, building more expertise around design approaches, driving best practices and improving the speed of delivery</li> <li>Lead code reviews to provide constructive direction</li> <li>Proactively simplifies code and resolves team architecture deficiencies</li>

Where You Come In You'll carry formal accountability for your team's performance, development, hiring, and day-to-day effectiveness — and you'll stay personally engaged in the region's most strategic accounts, at the level where a senior voice changes the outcome. If you're looking for a defined playbook or a steady renewal book to protect, this isn't that — you'll be building the playbook as you go. Build the account planning, escalation, and reporting processes that let the team absorb more enterprise customers without adding headcount at the same rate. Own performance outcomes for the accounts the team covers — net revenue retention, retention rates, health score distribution, and escalation resolution — and report cleanly to leadership. Grow usage inside existing accounts — across more teams, more markets, and more use cases Partner cross-functionally with Sales on renewals and new-account expansion, with Forward Deployed Creatives on workflow adoption, and with Product on what customers in the region need built next. Identify and develop talent — building a bench of strong individual contributors and emerging player-coaches who can grow with the organization. Lead hiring for the team as it scales, setting an explicit bar for what "senior" looks like in EMEA Customer Success. Set and maintain a high standard of execution across the team: account health, CRM hygiene, renewal management, expansion identification, and customer engagement quality. Serve as a senior point of escalation for complex customer situations that have exceeded what the team can resolve independently. Contribute to CS strategy alongside regional and functional leadership — bringing a ground-level view of team capability, customer patterns, and operational gaps into planning conversations. jobs.description: TL;DR: As our first Executive Assistant, you'll support Conduct's founders by protecting their time, keeping priorities moving and making the company feel sharper in how it runs day to day. It's a high-trust role, close to every big decision, at a company running faster than ever. Every process change, every new product line runs into software systems layered with decades of custom code and complexity no human mind can fully comprehend. New requirements take months to ship, system migrations cost $100M+ and years of pain. We're building the AI operating system that absorbs this complexity and gives enterprises back their speed and ambition. Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems, we've closed game-changing SI partnerships, just raised a $60M Series A, and demand is outpacing what we can service. We're a small, talent-dense team doing our life's work out of London and NYC. Extreme ownership, high velocity, low-ego collaboration. What you build here shapes the company and how the world's largest companies operate. We sponsor visas and are convinced diverse teams build better products, so we especially encourage underrepresented groups in tech to reach out. Their time is one of the most valuable things we have, and you'll help to decide how it gets spent. One day that means getting a CEO to a customer in Germany. You'll be our first EA, so you'll set the standard for how we support the founders. As we grow, the team around you might too, and you'll help shape how it works. Few roles give you this view of how a generational company gets built, and as we scale, your scope grows with us.
